jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position:**

Program Coordinator

**Department:**

Clinical

**Supervisor:**

Clinical Site Director

**FLSA Status:**

Full-Time; Non-Exempt

**Age of Patient Population Served:**

Adults and Adolescent

**Primary Purpose:**

The Program Coordinator provides comprehensive administrative support to the Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) teams while demonstrating a professional and respectful rapport with patients, families, and staff. This Coordinator also provides direct supportive care to selected patients, families, and the clinical team to ensure that services are delivered efficiently and effectively. This position is also the in-person administrative support for on-site outpatient patients and clinicians.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma
* Ability and interest in learning clinical information and criteria. Knowledge of medical terminology
* Computer literacy and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in social work or similar concentration.
* 1–2 years of experience in a healthcare setting is a plus.
* Google Workspace & EMR experience.
* Medical Assistant certification is a plus.

**Core Competencies:**

* Independent Judgment & Problem-Solving
* Organization & Time Management
* Professionalism, Integrity & Reliability
* Communication & Interpersonal Skills
* Adaptability & Team Collaboration
* Emotional Resilience & Patient Awareness

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide administrative support to the Program teams, including the Program Manager/Clinical Operations Director, Clinicians, and patients.
* Demonstrate professional and respectful rapport when interacting with all stakeholders, including patients, family members, co-workers, vendors, and other clinical staff.
* Conducts administrative duties including but not limited to:

  + Coordinate with Admissions to welcome new families to the program.
  + Maintain patient tracking list, updating as needed.
  + Scheduling group and session appointments for IOP/PHP patients.
  + Generating video calls for virtual IOP/PHP appointments.
  + Checking in and checking out patients.
  + Uploading registration paperwork.
  + Responding to email inquiries in a thorough, timely, and courteous manner.
  + Collecting and uploading paperwork.
  + Responding to the needs of patients, clinicians and program managers.
* Work closely with the Clinical Operations Director/Program Manager to coordinate group coverage as needed and provide updates about patient attendance and census.
* Report and track patient attendance and appointment charges daily.
* Facilitate the completion of daily electronic questionnaires with IOP/PHP patients.
* Attend weekly IOP/PHP treatment team meetings to review enrollment of new patients, identify scheduling and discharge planning needs, and facilitate next steps with scheduling.
* Taking vitals (weight, height, blood pressure) and drug test samples as needed.
* Clerical duties include copying, mailing, faxing, scanning, and sorting documentation.
* Performing other miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
* Submitting purchase orders for PHP/IOP Programs and the office as needed.
* Support Clinical Operations Director/Program Manager with Discharge coordination and administrative needs.
* Learn and perform general front desk duties to support outpatient administrative coverage.

  + Answering the phone, providing information, and routing calls appropriately.
  + Greeting outpatients and connecting them with their clinicians.
  + General facility maintenance and upkeep.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Mobility: Ability to move around the treatment facility as needed, including walking, standing, and occasional lifting or moving objects.

**Work Environment:**

* The work environment is conducted in an office setting.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Must be able to work in person at the Berkeley Clinic.

**BACA’s Core Values:**

BACA employees form a team with the highest standards who are individually and collectively committed to provide the highest level of care and service for our patient, their families and referents. As such, we require all of our employees to embody our core values detailed below:

**Integrity**: We are honest and accountable for our performance. We treat our patients and colleagues with respect and dignity.

**Quality:** We focus on consistent and competent performance of our duties. Careful attention to communication and follow-through produces excellent delivery of care.

**Compassion:** BACA prides itself on being a safe, comfortable, and contained environment that supports healing, recovery and hope. Every patient is treated with empathy, caring, and kindness.

**Collaboration:** We employ a “whole person” perspective to treatment. To that end, our program not only focuses on the patient, but the family system as well. We pool resources from patients, families, peers, partners and professionals to deliver exceptional care.

**Service:** We aid by creating a safe, calm shelter for our patients to risk exploring emotional issues that emerge in treatment.

jobs.title: Patient Care Navigator - San Francisco
jobs.description:
**About Rely Health**

At Rely Health, we leverage a comprehensive suite of technology tools to ensure every patient receives personalized support throughout their healthcare journey. Our patient care navigators utilize advanced AI-driven solutions, multi-channel communication platforms, and real-time data analytics to provide high-quality, cost-effective, and accessible care to diverse communities across the United States.

By combining human empathy with cutting-edge technology, Rely Health ensures comprehensive, efficient, and accessible care navigation for all patients, regardless of their location or circumstances. Our solution not only reduces worry and frustration for patients and their families but also improves overall health outcomes and reduces the total cost of care

**About the role**

As a Patient Care Navigator/Substance Use Navigator (SUN), you play an integral role in supporting medication for addiction treatment (MAT) while serving as an advocate to your patients throughout their transition from the acute care setting to outpatient treatment.

  

* This position will require Monday-Friday, 8-hour shifts between 9 a.m. and 5:30 p.m.
* This position will be working in the emergency department at a hospital in San Francisco
* Act as a Substance Use Navigator (SUN) to interact with patients, assess their readiness for treatment and links the patients to care.
* Utilizes motivational interviewing techniques to communicate with patients in a respectful, culturally appropriate, non-judgmental manner.
* Maintains up-to-date information about the effects of various substances, withdrawal symptoms, and treatment options to effectively educate and counsel patients.
* Provides liaison services to Addiction Medicine and outpatient clinics that manage addiction and wellness efforts towards sobriety.
* Required to attend and represent the organization at training and meetings at the request of CA Bridge program of the Public Health Institute.
* Clearly communicates the purposes and services available to patients, family members and caregivers.
* Promotes expansion of MAT program and philosophy within the hospital.
* Works with the patient to coordinate transition into or out of a care setting by following instructions they received from a medical professional. This may include faxing information, obtaining referrals or authorizations, arranging transportation, coordinating durable medical equipment (DME), making and confirming appointments, obtaining test results, and other patient related duties as designated.
* Practices regular communication with care team members to provide feedback around process improvement of services offered within the community, and to expand knowledge of those services that can better serve the patient and increase effectiveness of the role.
* Maintains frequent contact with SUN Program Supervisor and MAT Physician Champion to assist with other duties as assigned in support of other hospital initiatives. Interacts with the care team to collaboratively build a care pathway for patients to achieve sobriety and directs the execution of such a plan. Remains aware of and develops relationships with community resources and services offered, such as (and not limited to) mental health, housing, food, and employment assistance, and provides information on such services to patients as needed.
* Maintains privacy and confidentiality of any drug treatment efforts throughout the patient’s lifespan of treatment.
* Facilitates patients’ utilization of community resources to support patient wellness.
* Initiates steps to promote patients’ access to health insurance.
* Establishes relationships with, and serves as primary point of contact for, patients diagnosed with substance use disorder or co-occurring mental health disorders. If required by the hospital, this may include initial patient assessments and brief interventions using standardized tools.
* Maintains documentation of all client encounters in excel or software-based program and completes reporting requirements according to program standards.
* Fully discloses relevant training, experience, and credentials, in order to help patients, understand the scope of services the Substance Care Navigator is qualified to provide and refrains from any activity that could be construed as clinical in nature.
* Pay Range for this position is $25-$28/hour depending on experience

**Qualifications**

Requirements

* High school diploma or GED preferred.
* Understanding of substance use disorders (SUD) and medication assisted treatment (MAT).
* Nonjudgmental, energetic, positive, harm-reduction approach to assisting patients with Substance Use Disorder (SUD).
* Cultural competence in working with and serving populations whose social and cultural backgrounds are different from one’s own.
* Respect for patient confidentiality and privacy.
* Healthcare experience.
* Proficient in medical terminology.
* Knowledge of computer skills using Google Suite, Excel and e-mail.

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not exhaustive lists of all duties, responsibilities, knowledge, skills, abilities, and working conditions associated with it.

Rely Health is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**The Problem**

Severe mental illness affects over 15 million adults in the United States. Schizophrenia. Schizoaffective disorder. Bipolar I. Treatment-resistant depression. These are the conditions the rest of healthcare has systematically failed to build for.

What makes this problem different from most of healthcare is that the tools to solve it do not exist. The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. This is a frontier problem, and it requires frontier science and care delivery to solve.

We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

**Who We Are**

Amae Health is a Series B, venture-backed Public Benefit Corporation delivering specialty outpatient care for people with severe mental illness through high-acuity, in-person clinics nationwide.

Our integrated model brings psychiatry, therapy, primary care, dietitians, and community support together under one roof. Leading health systems—including **NewYork-Presbyterian, Cedars-Sinai, Mass General Brigham, Novant Health, and CommonSpirit**—partner with us to expand this level of care.

Alongside care delivery, we are building the science and technology the field has long lacked—proprietary clinical protocols, novel measurement, and an AI-driven data platform designed for severe mental illness.

The impact: fewer hospitalizations, greater stability, and more people living meaningful lives in their communities.

**The Team**

We are clinicians, operators, technologists, and scientists who chose Amae because the problem is hard and the stakes are real. We are not interested in incremental improvements to a broken system—we are redefining it.

Our teams work cross-functionally because the work demands it. The psychiatrist informs the product roadmap. Engineers understand the clinical complexity their technology must solve. Researchers sit alongside the operators running the clinics their work measures.

Every function—finance, product, people, growth, technology—exists to serve one goal: better outcomes for the people we care for.

**The Role**

The **Strategy & Operations** team at Amae plays a critical role in driving the programs and systems that support delivery of excellent care. This highly cross-functional role will work across a diverse range of teams and functions, leveraging complex problem-solving skills in a growth-oriented organization. This role is located in San Francisco, in office 5 days a week.

**What You Will Work On**

* Own the creation, rollout, and ongoing refinement of projects that support day-to-day behavioral health delivery; build structured workflows, playbooks, and feedback loops
* Partner with clinical and operational leaders to identify bottlenecks and design solutions that scale across markets
* Use data, user feedback, and operational insights to evaluate program performance and identify improvement opportunities
* Drive alignment across clinical, operations, product, and leadership teams to ensure programs are implemented smoothly and sustainably
* Lead communication, training, and rollout plans for new initiatives

**What You'll Have**

* 3+ years of experience within private equity management consulting, investment banking, venture capital, or within a healthcare organization driving initiatives from ideation to implementation
* Scrappy, self-starter mindset who vigorously looks for ways to grow an early-stage company
* Proven experience structuring and leading projects to drive successful outcomes
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, and problem-solving skills with high proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience in a startup and/or entrepreneurial environment; ability to thrive in a fast-paced culture, growing 0–1
* Passion and interest for the mental health space
* Bachelor's Degree required

**What We're Building**

Most healthcare companies ask you to optimize an existing system. We're building one that has never existed.

* A national care model designed for the highest-acuity patients in behavioral health.
* Precision medicine for severe mental illness, using multimodal clinical, behavioral, and social data to personalize treatment.
* A clinical operating system that integrates longitudinal data, real-time patient signals, and purpose-built tools into a single decision layer.
* New science and measurement frameworks to define what real outcomes look like in SMI.
* A health-system partnership model proving coordinated SMI care can work at scale.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Amae Health is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **Base salary range for this role is $125,000 to $165,000 per year** based on a full-time schedule; the compensation package will include equity. Total compensation includes comprehensive medical/dental/vision, unlimited PTO, parental leave, and programs built around employee well-being. We'll share specifics during the interview process.

*Amae Health is building the care platform, the precision medicine, and the frontier science that severe mental illness has never had. If you want to be part of creating something this hard and this important, something that has never been done, we'd like to talk.*

**What We Value**

* **We center care in all we do.** Empathy is not a brand value. It's how we make clinical decisions, build products, and treat each other.
* **We challenge convention.** The existing system is the problem. We question it, we test alternatives, and we move with urgency when something works.
* **We take the work seriously, not ourselves.** High standards and humanity are not in tension. We hold a hard bar for quality while leaving room for humor and levity.
* **Your job isn't done until the job is done.** We close gaps, we follow through, and we don't hide behind titles or org charts.
* **We win together and fail toge

jobs.title: Patient Navigator
jobs.description:
**Trial Library is an AI-native research platform with a mission to improve healthcare outcomes by expanding access to precision medicine.**

**About Trial Library**

Trial Library is an AI-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option - improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care. Backed by leading healthcare venture capital firms, Trial Library’s platform is currently deployed in 840+ clinics and 3,000+ providers nationwide.

### **About the Role:**

As a Patient Navigator, you'll do more than guide patients through the clinical trial enrollment process—you'll help shape the future of how patients access precision medicine.

You will serve as a trusted partner to patients with cancer and their caregivers, helping them understand clinical trial opportunities, overcome barriers to care, and navigate complex healthcare systems with empathy and confidence. You'll also work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Clinical teams to continuously improve the patient experience and influence how our navigation services evolve.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone with a nursing background who combines clinical expertise with a passion for patient advocacy and enjoys building new processes in a fast-paced, mission-driven startup environment.

### **Your Responsibilities**

**Patient Navigation & Advocacy**

* Serve as a trusted liaison between patients, caregivers, healthcare providers, and clinical research sites.
* Guide patients through the clinical trial referral, screening, and enrollment journey.
* Educate patients and families on clinical trial opportunities and precision medicine.
* Identify and help remove barriers to care by connecting patients with appropriate resources.
* Coordinate medical record collection and facilitate seamless handoffs to research sites.
* Maintain ongoing communication and support throughout the patient journey.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Clinical teams to improve the patient experience.
* Respond to inquiries from patients, providers, and internal stakeholders.
* Provide feedback that informs new workflows, features, and service offerings.

**Operations**

* Document patient interactions and maintain accurate case records.
* Contribute to SOPs, educational content, and operational documentation.
* Track key navigation metrics and prepare reports on patient outcomes and team activities.
* Help build and scale Trial Library's patient navigation program as the company grows.

### **Your Qualifications**

* Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN), Associate Degree in Nursing (ADN), or equivalent nursing degree required. *An active RN or LPN license is not required.*
* 2+ years of experience supporting oncology patients, patient navigation, clinical research, or a related healthcare setting.
* Working knowledge of clinical trials and the patient enrollment process.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex medical information to diverse audiences.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple patients, priorities, and deadlines.
* Demonstrated empathy, sound judgment, and a patient-first approach.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with evolving priorities.
* Proficiency with electronic health records (EHRs), CRM systems, or similar healthcare technology platforms.
* Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth startup.

### **Nice to Have**

* Oncology clinical trial enrollment or study coordination experience.
* Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC), CCRP, or other clinical research certification.
* Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, or Operations teams to improve workflows or services.
* Experience developing SOPs, patient education materials, or operational processes.
* Multilingual (Spanish, Mandarin, Cantonese, or other languages commonly spoken by oncology patient populations).
* Familiarity with precision medicine, biomarker testing, or molecular diagnostics.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, with a requirement of three days per week in the office; Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. jobs.description:
Strategy & Operations - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Forward Deployment Strategy & Operations team closely partners with GTM leadership and Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) to help organizations move from AI ambition to durable production outcomes. We combine technical depth, deployment expertise, and commercial and operational discipline to solve complex problems in customer environments and accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s models and products.

We also work across Technical Success, Finance, Product, Legal, Data, Systems, and external delivery partners to build a forward deployed motion that is customer-centered, commercially rigorous, operationally scalable, and tightly connected to product adoption.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a senior operator to build and scale OpenAI’s forward deployed business. You will lead some of our highest-priority strategic initiatives across the company, tackling ambiguous and complex questions about how to bring the full capabilities of our models to the world’s largest and most consequential institutions.

This is a foundational, hands-on individual contributor role at the intersection of business strategy, finance, go-to-market, and technical delivery. You will shape where and how we engage, how we structure and commercialize deployments, how we scale the motion, and where we invest—turning open-ended questions into clear strategies, decisions, and operating models.

You will own business planningance; replace one-off analyses with durable processes; and establish operating cadences that help leaders act early.

You will be a trusted partner to FDE, GTM, Technical Success, Finance, Product, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Data leaders. The right person combines experience with complex customer deployments, rigorous analytics, executive communication, and the willingness to build the model, process, or dashboard themselves.

**You’ll be responsible for:**

* Define and drive the business and GTM strategy for the forward deployed motion, including target customer needs, engagement portfolio, positioning, commercial models, partner motions, and where to standardize versus tailor deployments.
* Lead high-priority, cross-company strategic initiatives that shape how OpenAI scales the FDE business and brings the capabilities of its models to the world’s largest and most complex institutions, from problem definition through implementation.
* Own long-range, annual, and quarterly planning, translating goals into bookings, revenue, margin, capacity, utilization, role mix, geography, hiring, and investment assumptions.
* Build and maintain integrated demand, capacity, staffing, and revenue models; develop scenarios and sensitivities; improve bottom-up forecast accuracy; and turn the output into clear executive recommendations.
* Design the management system for the business, including KPIs, source-of-truth reporting, dashboards, pipeline and staffing reviews, and monthly and quarterly operating cadences.
* Improve the end-to-end engagement lifecycle—from opportunity intake and scoping through commercial design, contracting, staffing, deployment, and expansion—in partnership with Revenue Operations and Systems.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, GTM, FDE, Technical Success, and delivery leaders on business cases, deployment economics, deal tradeoffs, resource allocation, and investment decisions.
* Translate recurring customer and deployment patterns into inputs for product strategy, enablement, partner strategy, and more repeatable product-plus-deployment offerings that accelerate durable adoption.

**We’re looking for someone with:**

* 8+ years of experience in management consulting, Business Operations, Strategic Finance, or a comparable role, including direct experience in a forward-deployed engineering, enterprise implementation, technical consulting, systems-integration, or managed-services organization.
* Deep command of deployment economics and operating levers such as pipeline, bookings, backlog, revenue timing, gross margin, utilization, capacity, staffing mix, delivery quality, and customer outcomes.
* Exceptional quantitative modeling skills: you can build auditable demand, staffing, revenue, and scenario models; work fluently in spreadsheets; and use SQL, BI, or other data tools to test assumptions and improve decisions.
* Strong commercial and GTM judgment across engagement design, pricing and packaging, forecasting, resource allocation, and complex enterprise deployment motions.
* A record of leading complex, ambiguous strategic initiatives and turning them into clear choices, scalable operating models, and measurable results.
* Excellent executive communication and influence; you can frame choices, surface assumptions, and drive alignment across technical and non-technical leaders.
* Demonstrated leadership of complex cross-functional programs and teams. People-management experience is helpful, but this role is initially scoped as a senior individual contributor.
* A low-ego, high-ownership working style, comfort with rapid change, and genuine interest in how frontier AI can create durable customer value.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Premium Nep International Trading & Business Solutions LLC is seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven **Senior E-commerce Operations Manager** to oversee online retail operations, optimize digital sales channels, and lead operational initiatives that improve customer experience, order fulfillment, and business profitability.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in e-commerce operations, digital marketplaces, inventory management, international trade, and supply chain optimization. This role requires a strong operations leader who can manage cross-functional teams, streamline online business processes, improve fulfillment performance, and support sustainable revenue growth.

This position offers an opportunity to lead large-scale e-commerce initiatives, develop operational strategies, and strengthen digital commerce performance across domestic and international markets.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead daily e-commerce operations across online stores, digital marketplaces, and direct-to-consumer sales channels.
* Develop and execute e-commerce operational strategies aligned with business growth and profitability objectives.
* Oversee online store performance, product listings, pricing coordination, inventory availability, and order processing.
* Manage e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace, or comparable systems.
* Lead operations teams responsible for order management, inventory coordination, fulfillment, and customer support.
* Optimize warehouse operations, shipping processes, returns management, and third-party logistics relationships.
* Coordinate international sourcing, supplier relationships, import/export activities, and cross-border fulfillment.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including conversion rates, order accuracy, fulfillment costs, delivery performance, and return rates.
* Implement inventory forecasting, demand planning, and stock replenishment strategies.
* Collaborate with marketing, finance, technology, logistics, and customer service teams.
* Oversee integrations between e-commerce platforms, enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and inventory management software.
* Manage operational budgets, vendor contracts, logistics expenses, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Develop quality assurance procedures, customer experience standards, and operational risk controls.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, process improvements, and scalable e-commerce infrastructure.
* Prepare operational performance reports, financial analyses, and strategic recommendations for executive leadership.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, E-commerce, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 7+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, digital retail, marketplace management, or supply chain operations.
* At least 3 years of management experience leading operational teams or cross-functional business initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing high-volume online sales operations and fulfillment processes.
* Strong knowledge of Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Marketplace, or similar e-commerce platforms.
* Experience with inventory planning, warehouse operations, logistics coordination, and third-party fulfillment providers.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce performance metrics, customer experience, and operational profitability.
* Experience with ERP systems, order management systems (OMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), and CRM platforms.
* Knowledge of international sourcing, customs procedures, and cross-border e-commerce operations.
* Experience managing budgets, vendor negotiations, and operational improvement projects.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Analytics 4, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools.
* Excellent leadership, communication, strategic planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage complex operational priorities, seasonal demand fluctuations, and business growth initiatives.
* Familiarity with marketplace compliance, consumer protection requirements, and e-commerce data security practices.
* Experience with automation, AI-enabled analytics, or digital commerce transformation is an asset.

**Why Work With Us**

* Opportunity to lead strategic e-commerce operations and digital business expansion.
* Collaborative environment combining international trading, technology, and online retail management.
* Exposure to digital marketplaces, supply chain technologies, and e-commerce automation.
* Opportunities for senior leadership development and professional advancement.
* Ability to influence operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business profitability.
* Competitive senior-management compensation and performance-based incentives.

**About the Company**

Premium Nep International Trading & Business Solutions LLC is positioned as an international trading and business solutions company focused on digital commerce, global sourcing, online retail operations, and business process optimization.

The Senior E-commerce Operations Manager role supports scalable online business operations, efficient order fulfillment, international supply chain coordination, and continuous improvement in digital commerce performance.

jobs.description:
Description:

The Street Heath Outreach Program is an innovative project which identifies homelessness, chronic health, and mental health needs in Central Alameda County. The program will assist people in attaining housing stability and improve health and well-being. Using a multi-disciplined team approach, the program provides street and venue-based outreach and engagement, assessment, health services and triage, case management, as well as linkages to housing agencies and mental health services. The program will work with all participants to develop and carry out action plans that improve health and wellness.

Under the supervision of the Director of Population Health, the **Street Health Outreach Community Health Worker** will work directly with participants to access housing programs, assist with enrollment and/or maintenance of Medi-Cal or HealthPAC, and provide navigational support to successfully engage participants to a medical home. Other activities include health education, care plan development, public benefit linkage and assisting the participant with accessing TVHC health care services.

**Schedule:** This is a full-time position, working 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday hours.

**About TVHC:** Tiburcio Vasquez Health Center is a nonprofit community health center dedicated to promoting the health and well-being of our community by providing accessible, high-quality care through the integration of primary care, dental care, WIC support, mental health counseling, community health education, and more.

**Benefits:** We offer excellent benefits, including: medical (100% paid co-payments, premiums, etc.), dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous paid leave benefits including holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement plans with an Employer match, tuition reimbursement, monthly treats, pet insurance, and more.

\*As position is grant-funded, employment is subject to the availability of grant funding\*

**Compensation:** $24.00 - $26.00 per hour, depending on experience.

*This position is represented by SEIU, with compensation and benefits determined by the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). Salary is based on the wage scales outlined in the agreement. Beyond base pay, TVHC provides a comprehensive compensation package that supports the health, wealth, and career development of our employees.*

**Responsibilities:**

* Engages, empowers and advocates for Alameda County unsheltered residents and helps them achieve their best health.
* Conducts regular street outreach and engagement, building trust with individuals encountered at encampments and other service locations according to the responsive schedule.
* Attends to immediate survival needs as prioritized by clients, e.g. distributing basic necessities and supplies.
* Provides problem-solving support using Motivational Interviewing techniques.
* Creates a care plan that reflects the client’s need based on outreach assessment.
* Coordinates linkages to various community resources to meet these needs and works from an interdisciplinary approach.
* Provides case management services in a culturally, linguistically and age appropriate manner.
* Serves as a liaison between the client, community and health and social services.
* Assists clients with enrollment and maintenance of MediCal and Medicare eligibility as well as with other benefits such as CalFresh, GA and SSI.
* Provides culturally competent, trauma informed health services.
* Maintains client information and case documentation in a confidential and professional manner.
* Completes Coordinated Enrry Assessments for individuals seeking housing.
* Maintains client data and responsible for updating county database on a monthly basis.
* Adheres to organizational policy and procedures.
* Builds and maintains appropriate relationships with staff, encampment leaders and Housing Resource Centers.
* Supports a positive work environment and fosters teamwork.
* Represents Street Outreach team at county and community based organization events and meetings.
* Participates with other staff in multidisciplinary meetings and other staff processes to achieve program development, staff development, program evaluation, program operations review, and other activities as appropriate.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and expectations required of the position.*

Requirements:

* High school diploma, or equivalent required.
* BLS certification required.

**Qualifications:**

* Associate of Arts Degree preferred.
* Minimum of one (1) year experience providing outreach to chronically unhoused individuals preferred.
* Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EHR) preferred.
* Bilingual; English/Spanish preferred.
* Lived experience of homelessness valued.
* Be highly dependable and independent.
* Good communication; ability to work well within a team and independently.
* Proficiency in computer operations, navigational skills and comfortable with Internet-based applications.
* Sound decision-making skills including problem solving.
* Professional demeanor.
* Sensitivity to and understanding of the special needs of unsheltered people facing complex challenges.
* Excellent communication, organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet tight timeframes.
* Strong understanding of the health care and community resources.
* Must be willing to travel to assigned locations and drive street health medicine van to and from various service sites as needed.
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively.
* Flexible and adaptable to change.
* Ability to learn quickly and retain complex information.
* Ability to travel to work assignments.

**Position Overview**

BANANAS Inc. is seeking a **Client Services Enrollment Counselor.** The Client Services Enrollment Counselor is responsible for contacting and enrolling new families from the BANANAS Eligibility List (BEL) into our California Alternative Payment Programs (CAPP). This position also transfers eligible families into our CalWORKs Stage 2 program while providing excellent customer service throughout the enrollment process.

This position performs duties in support of BANANAS’ mission and program operations. The duties listed below represent the essential functions of the position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform these essential functions.

Job duties, responsibilities, work locations, and schedules may change based on organizational needs.

**About BANANAS Inc.**

BANANAS is a nonprofit organization that supports families, children, and early care and education providers. Our programs help families connect with all types of child care options, from family child care, home-based settings, preschool centers, family, friend, neighbor caregivers, and nannies, so they can work or continue their education. Providers are supported with technical assistance and professional development. We are experts in the field of early care and education, and our wide variety of services supports families and child care providers in raising early learners. We offer workshops, playgroups, coaching, and support groups for parents and caregivers. Low-income families are supported with financial assistance so they can access quality child care. BANANAS is a great place to work with colleagues who care about their clients, our youngest learners, and each other.

**Primary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Contact families from the BANANAS Eligibility List (BEL).
* Meet with parents/guardians and/or child care providers to verify initial assessment information.
* Complete family applications, obtain signatures on childcare provider agreements, and enter families' and child care providers' information into KinderSystems database.
* Calculate income to determine family eligibility.
* Enter information for upcoming documentation requests and changes into the KinderSystem database.
* Clarify and answer questions to ensure parents and providers understand the program policies and procedures.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of all guidelines, regulations, and policies and procedures.
* Send Notice Of Action (NOA) and Contract Amendments to parents and child care providers, as needed.
* Receive and enroll CalWORKs Stage 2 transfers from Stage 1 agencies.
* Enroll eligible Stage 2 families who come to BANANAS within our service areas.
* Communicate with and enroll any out-of-county transfers (CalWORKs) from other agencies.
* Submit family files to Quality Assurance (QA) for review
* Conduct child care provider intakes and enter information into KinderSystems database
* Maintain a small caseload
* Monitor caseloads to determine families' needs for child care services
* Recertify families and update information in files and KinderSystems database

**Secondary Duties and Responsibilities**

* Assist with client calls, walk-ins, and inquiries while collecting and documenting information in client files or the KinderSystems database, as required.
* Maintain a working knowledge of Resource & Referral services.
* Coordinate one annual staff development training for the Client Services team.
* Perform all duties in accordance with organizational policies, values, and strategic priorities. Assume additional responsibilities and complete special projects as assigned.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Responsibilities may change at any time, with or without notice.

**Role Scope**

This position is responsible for performing assigned duties in support of BANANAS’ programs and operations. This role does not include supervisory responsibility over staff.

Employees are expected to follow established procedures, collaborate with team members, and escalate issues as appropriate.

**Work Location Flexibility and Travel Requirements**

This position may be assigned to work at different locations to support program needs, coverage requirements, and operational priorities. Employees are expected to demonstrate flexibility in work assignments and locations.

Travel between BANANAS’ locations during the workday will be considered compensable hours worked for non-exempt staff, and business mileage and approved work-related expenses will be reimbursed in accordance with California Labor Code Section 2802 and BANANAS’ policy.

This position is assigned to a designated, fully equipped BANANAS workspace. While partial telecommuting may be permitted as a convenience to the employee, on-site workspace and resources remain fully available. Voluntary remote work expenses associated with a home office (such as home internet or utilities) are not deemed necessary job expenditures and are not subject to reimbursement, unless otherwise required by law or pre-approved in writing by the Human Resources Department. Employees are expected to utilize BANANAS-provided communication tools and equipment for all business tasks; use of personal devices for work purposes must be pre-authorized.

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent
* 1-2 years of data entry experience
* 2 or more years of customer service experience
* Basic math skills
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Computer experience: Microsoft Word, Excel and Google Suite

* Knowledge of California child care laws and regulations

* Understanding of State regulations

It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry-leading environmental efforts. We do this by obsessing over the employee and customer experience, and driving a global strategy that sets the bar. Today at Apple Operations team enables the field to create the best learning experience and events that inspire customers to discover, own, and love Apple products and services.We collaborate cross-functionally, define success metrics, analyze performance, and partner globally to ensure seamless implementation and continuous improvement of initiatives. We are looking for an outstanding Program Manager that is skilled at creating, building, leading, ideating, planning, and driving tools, programs, and resources that enable and equip teams and leaders to best care for customers. ### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a business or quantitative discipline (e.g., Business Administration, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Physics) or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in business development, partnerships or corporate strategy.

* Experience working in corporate development, venture capital, or a startup accelerator/incubator with a direct focus on early-stage AI investments and strategic partnerships.
* Experience communicating, presenting, and influencing a range of audiences, including executives.
* Demonstrated experience of problem-solving skills, including modeling and presentation skills. Excellent leadership, communication and collaboration skills.

**About the job**
-----------------

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. As part of this team you fully immerse yourself in data collection, draw insight from analysis, and then zoom out to develop compelling, synthesized recommendations. Taking strategy one step further, you also persuasively communicate your recommendations to senior-level executives, roll-up your sleeves to help drive implementation and check back-in to see the impact of your recommendations.

The AI Futures Fund (AIFF) is a strategic investment and incubation initiative within Google Labs. Our mission is to accelerate the pioneers building what’s next in artificial intelligence bridging frontier research from DeepMind into real-world commercial startup innovation. In this role, you will partner with ambitious early-stage founders and global venture ecosystems, pairing day-zero model access and deep technical collaboration with strategic capital and Google-scale infrastructure.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $147000 - $213000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and refine investment theses and engaged landscape analyses on early-stage AI startups—evaluating product defensibility, model utilization, and market opportunities to guide direct investments.
* Scout and source high-potential, early-stage, global AI startups, and partner with venture capital firms and regional stakeholders to help structure, launch, and operationalize joint investment funds.
* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of regional Applied AI Labs globally—spearheading new market launches, running startup cohort selection and evaluation loops, directing day-to-day lab operations, and establishing scalable playbooks to expand across international venture hubs.
* Author high-stakes executive briefing documents, decision memos, and investment theses to support fund leadership in Investment Committee (IC) forums, while directly owning and leading presentations in cross-functional, operational, and director-level decision forums.
* Lead the fund’s executive cadence of business, driving quarterly strategic reviews, executive syncs, and leadership alignment across Google Labs, DeepMind, and Google Cloud.

jobs.description:
Finance - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For Infra, our focus is on providing tooling for visibility across the life cycle of data center infrastructure that feeds accurate accounting and finance records. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations.

**About the Role**

As Program Manageration, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, construction, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery.

You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption.
* Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths.
* Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance.
* Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review.
* Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs.
* Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments.
* Partner with applications, with monitoring and governed change controls.
* Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact.
* Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* 8+ years of experience in project or program managementation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments.
* Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting.
* Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.
* A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design.
* Fluency in data dependenciess.
* Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive updates that explain decisions, risks, business impact, and specific actions needed.
* Experience driving complex initiatives through ambiguity and organizational change, with clear evidence of hands-on delivery and adoption. Cloud FinOps, infrastructure finance, or capacity-planning experience is a strong plus.

FORMA Construction, an award-winning firm, seeks a motivated, detail-oriented Assistant Project Manager to help build the most complex and detailed projects.

The Assistant Project Manager role is a critical hub for FORMA. In coordination with the Project Manager and the Superintendent; the APM works closely with clients, architects, designers, subcontractors, and other vendors. The APM tracks progress and updates budgets while keeping the project well-documented and running smoothly ensuring that our clients are informed and consulted every step of the way.

Success in this role is measured by your ability to maintain project documents like RFI's and Submittals among other tasks within Procore while maintaining good relations with our clients, vendors, and other stakeholders.

At FORMA, our Mission is the continual development of our people and processes to create lasting relationships built on integrity, partnership, and craft. Our core values are based on building relationships, collaborating to create the best possible outcomes, mutual respect, continued growth, and excellent craftsmanship. FORMA’s clients and work sites take us throughout the greater Bay Area, building a range of styles and requirements, but all our projects share the same level of dedication, detail, and communication. Our Assistant Project Manager will ensure that our clients receive the best possible service, while continuing to build their experience in project management.

The Port’s jurisdiction covers approximately 7.5 miles of waterfront land from Pier 98, near Hunter’s Point in the southern part of San Francisco, to Fisherman’s Wharf in the northern part of the City.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Salary range: $90,000 - $115,000 annually, plus potential bonus.

The Associate Project Manager I is responsible for supporting the construction project team during the design and construction of a project in accordance with Holland Partner Group’s Core Values.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**

* Participate in writing proposals and preparing components of conceptual and detailed estimates for review with supervisor.
* Review construction and shop drawings for constructability, conflicts, or other details related to construction.
* Assist in writing specifications to assigned projects.
* Assist or manage design, construction and/or close-out on assigned projects.
* Assist in preparation of change orders for supervisor’s review.
* Review drawings, budgets, schedules and other project related matters with jobsite superintendent.
* Assist project superintendents with on-site duties to assure project goals and company policies are being adhered to, such as quality assurance & quality control measures, safety, documenting design changes, drafting and logging RFI’s, and general observation and guidance of subcontractor work, as assigned.

* Assist in preparing subcontractor bid packages and bid tabulations.

* Assist with negotiating and drafting subcontracts for project manager’s review.

* Assist with monitoring, reviewing and controlling project costs to ensure project completion on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with established goals.

* Work to optimize team effectiveness and help coordinate the project team.
* Develop and maintain productive working relationship with team, company personnel, and subcontractors.
* Monitor, enforce and maintain job safety for the project by supporting and participating in all safety programs, ensuring all crew is using required safety equipment and continually monitoring the job site to ensure safety requirements are met in accordance with Holland safety polices.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

**Education:** High School diploma required. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or related field strongly preferred (preference to Engineering degree).

**Experience**: Zero to three-years full-time experience with a Bachelor’s Degree, as noted herein, preferably with design-build and construction experience and / or related internships. Extensive construction experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. Professional engineering or architectural registration is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**

* Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with all levels of employees while inspiring respect and credibility.

* Ability to work independently; self-starting and driven.

* Ability to read and interpret construction documents.

* Ability to solve problems and use available resources.
* Knowledge of the design-build process.

* Proficient in the use of MS Office, specifically Word, Excel and Outlook.

* Ability to command a mastery of company used software such as Procore, Bluebeam and others.

jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Uber is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Tech (L5) to lead LLM quality and evaluation programs across multilingual products and AI-powered experiences. You will define how we measure model quality, identify failures, and determine whether AI solutions are ready for production.  
  
Working across Engineering, LLMOps within the Localization Technology team, Multilingual Program manager, Product, and vendors, you will build, assess or improve the existing evaluation frameworks that validate model performance by language, market, content type, cultural nuance, and audiences. This role requires strong technical fluency in LLM behavior, understanding NLP, and the program leadership to turn evaluation findings into measurable improvements.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* **Own the LLM quality and evaluation roadmap.** Define program goals, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and release criteria across models and use cases.
* **Build scalable evaluation frameworks.** Establish statistically defensible methods to assess accuracy such as recall and precision, relevance, completeness, instruction following, linguistic quality, and cultural appropriateness.
* **Develop high-quality evaluation datasets.** Lead the creation, annotation, adjudication, versioning, and maintenance of golden datasets that represent real user needs, challenging scenarios, and multilingual requirements.
* **Evaluate model and system failures.** Partner with technical teams to assess hallucinations, prompt-injection susceptibility, unsupported claims, context loss, and inconsistent outputs. Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and citation accuracy.
* **Lead human and automated evaluation.** Establish reviewer guidelines, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems against expert assessments, and measure agreement, false positives, false negatives, and severity classification.
* **Drive model fitness decisions.** Collaborating with LLMOpn in the Localization Technology team to compare models and configurations by locale, task, quality, cost, and latency to inform model selection, routing, and deployment.
* **Close the quality improvement loop.** Translate findings into prioritized improvements to prompts, retrieval, terminology, workflows, and model configurations. Partner with owners to verify fixes and prevent regressions.
* **Operationalize continuous quality monitoring.** Establish regression testing, production sampling, quality dashboards, escalation processes, and ongoing evaluation as models and user needs evolve.
* **Lead cross-functional execution.** Clarify ownership, resolve dependencies, communicate risks, and align stakeholders on quality tradeoffs and launch readiness.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Operations, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Experience leading complex technical programs involving AI/ML, software platforms, quality engineering, or data-driven products.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver cross-functional programs with Engineering, Localization team, Data Scientist, Product, and Operations.
* Working understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, including hallucinations, prompt engineering, prompt injection, RAG, context management, and tool use.
* Experience designing quality metrics, evaluation methodologies, human-review workflows, or experimental programs.
* Ability to interpret statistical results, assess dataset quality, and communicate the limitations of evaluation findings to leaderships and LLMOps.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and written communication skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into executable plans.
* Experience evaluating multilingual LLMs, machine translation, conversational AI, or localization quality.
* Familiarity with MQM-based evaluation, terminology governance, and market-specific linguistic requirements.
* Experience with LLM evaluation platforms, automated regression pipelines, and production observability.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, APIs, and data pipelines sufficient to investigate results and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
* Experience evaluating multimodal systems, including text, image, audio, or video.
* Experience establishing quality standards and launch criteria for AI systems operating at scale.

The San Francisco Unified School District (SFUSD) is the seventh largest school district in California, serving more than 50,000 students who speak more than 44 documented languages across 121 schools in the city of San Francisco every year. We aim for every student who attends SFUSD schools to discover his or her spark, along with a strong sense of self and purpose, and that all students graduate from high school ready for college and career, and equipped with the skills, capacities and dispositions outlined in SFUSD’s Graduate Profile. Every day in our quest to achieve this mission we provide each and every student the quality instruction and equitable support required to thrive in the 21st century.

The SFUSD community is unified by ourCore Values:

* Student-centered: We put students’ needs first
* Fearless: We persist through challenges
* United: We celebrate and build on each other’s strengths
* Social Justice: We stand with those most vulnerable in our community
* Diversity-driven: We respect and seek to understand each person

We are also inspired by Vision, Values and Guardrails which captures our aspirations and vision for the future of public education in San Francisco. jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Relief) - Palo Alto, CA
jobs.description:
**ABOUT VEG**

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

  

**THE JOB**

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer's experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online
* Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly
* Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say "yes" to customer needs
* Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate
* Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience
* Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions
* Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information
* Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet's care and strengthen relationships
* Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

  

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* 2+ years of experience in a customer service role
* Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software
* Highly organized, with strong attention to detail
* Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
* The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos
* High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly
* Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments
* Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation
* Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
* Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs
* Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
* Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team's' accomplishments
* Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
* Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

  

**HOW WE INVEST IN YOU**

* Competitive compensation: Pay range is $20-$30 per hour, based on experience
* Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work
* Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people
* And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you're hungry

  

**DEI**

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is "Helping people and their pets when they need it most." And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world's veterinary emergency company.

**Title:** Immigrant Defense Community Care Coordinator  
**Hours:** 40 hours per week – Non – Exempt; 100% In person  
**Reports to:** Immigrant Defense Lead Organizer (Manager)

**About Street Level Health Project:** Street Level Health Project (SLHP) is an Oakland-based nonprofit dedicated to improving the health, dignity, and well-being of underserved immigrant communities in the Bay Area. For more than two decades, Street Level has served as a trusted point of entry for workers and families facing barriers to healthcare, employment, legal services, and more. Our work is grounded in the belief that everyone deserves dignity, respect, and the opportunity to thrive regardless of immigration status or economic circumstance.

**About the Immigrant Defense (ID) Program:** The ID program works in coalition with partners like the Alameda County Immigration Legal and Education Partnership Rapid Response Network (ACILEP RNN), Adopt-A-Corner, and others to respond to the needs of the immigrant community. This is an agile, responsive program that works closely with the SLHP Day Labor Program and the Health & Well-Being Program. The program strives to build community within the movement and Bay Area ecosystem.

**Position Summary:** The ID Community Care Coordinator (CCC) helps families prepare in case of detention or deportation and supports families impacted by the detention or deportation of a community member.
