jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980. Today, Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD's headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides community development, real estate facilities, and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low-income US-born high-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional-age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** LFCD is seeking a dedicated and qualified candidate to serve Alameda County’s non-English or Limited English Proficiency CalWORKs (California Work Opportunity and Responsibility to Kids, RCA (Refugee Cash Assistance), GA (General Assistance), and CalFresh (formerly known as Food Stamps) recipients, and low-income individuals in obtaining both subsidized and unsubsidized employment. This position will also manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs.This position involves working closely with local employers, training providers, external organizations, and internal LFCD departments. The key responsibilities include providing orientation, conducting intake assessments, creating Individual Employment Plans (IEP), outreach recruitment for employers and job seekers, case management, vocational training counseling, job placement, and offering retention services. The role requires the implementation of program activities and strategies focused on the long-term career advancement of each participant. Additionally, it involves understanding the hiring and business development needs of each employer, adhering to the policy and compliance requirements of Alameda County Social Services Agency, and navigating the various factors that influence an individual’s ability to thrive and advance in the workplace. This position reports to the Program Supervisor and will be stationed at our Oakland Headquarters.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and conduct program orientation sessions, intake and assessments, job readiness workshops, and one-on-one and small group counseling. Develop Welfare-to-Work (WTW2) Plans, IEPs, resumes, and cover letters. Identify participant needs to determine appropriate job interests and matches to secure job placements and provide job retention services.
* Provide intensive services to participants, including certifying and obtaining all required supportive documents for program enrollment. Identify career goals, make appropriate referrals, and provide labor market information, job fairs, job clubs, and job referrals.
* Counsel participants individually and in groups on job search strategies, interviewing skills, and other job readiness topics to assist them in entering the job market, retaining employment, and/or advancing in their careers to become self-sufficient.
* Collaborate effectively with employment teams, VESL instructors, and consortium partners to recommend and refer potential candidates for weekly job openings.
* Take the lead in coordinating, implementing, and managing the Short-Term Food Assistance Program and RSI (Refugee School Impact) / YM (Youth Mentoring) Program, including program planning, participant enrollment, outreach, intake, eligibility determination, service coordination, documentation, follow-up, day-to-day operations, case management, recordkeeping, and reporting to ensure program goals, service outcomes, and grant compliance requirements are met.
* Maintain accurate case records, statistics, and service logs for project reporting purposes. Track participants, enter data, and maintain daily logs, case notes, and all other activities in the internal tracking system and funder-specific CalSAWS database accurately.
* Provide data and administrative support to the Grant Department across various grant-funded programs, including collecting, entering, organizing, reviewing, and verifying program data; maintaining databases, spreadsheets, participant records, and reporting templates; resolving data discrepancies; and supporting data tracking, performance monitoring, and timely grant reporting to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Conduct outreach in the community to provide program information and attend resource fairs to recruit low-income Alameda County residents, including older youth, adults, and dislocated workers. Promote programs by creating flyers and other promotional materials.
* Target and reach out to prospective employers with job openings at reasonable starting wages with fringe benefits. Provide employer orientations, cultivate and maintain business relationships with employers, provide program information, and refer program participants based on their experiences, interests, and job readiness.
* Maintain existing employer business relationships and contracts while developing new business opportunities in the local area to expand the employer directory. Conduct surveys with employers and participants following placement to ensure job stability.
* Prepare and submit monthly program activity reports, performance updates, and other required reports to the program supervisor and Grant Department, as applicable.
* Be knowledgeable about the agency's mission, vision, core values, and strategic plan. Participate in agency initiatives to improve program and service quality and help accomplish the agency's strategic plan goals and objectives.
* Perform other duties as assigned, and participate in organizational and program-related events as needed or assigned by the program supervisor.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degre

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager - Multidisciplinary Teams
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Senior Program Manager, Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs)

**Department:** Strategic Partnerships & Policy (SPP)

**Reports to:** Chief Policy Officer (CPO)

**Location:** 3450 Third Street, San Francisco, CA 94124

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**

Safe & Sound's mission is to prevent and reduce the impact of childhood abuse, neglect, and trauma. We do this by strengthening families, building communities, and advancing healing, equity, and justice. We envision a future free from childhood trauma, where all children, families, and communities are safe, supported, and loved.

Combining direct services, training and capacity building, research, and advocacy to strengthen families in their communities, address childhood trauma, and prevent abuse, Safe & Sound has evolved into a premiere child-serving organization, bringing over 50 years of service to our community.

We reach more than 11,000 caregivers and children annually with our unique coordinated, multi-generational approach that spans the entire spectrum of prevention and intervention to strengthen family resilience and address factors that put families at risk for experiencing abuse or involvement in unsubstantiated abuse allegations.

The organization has an annual operating budget of approximately $10.8 million and is supported by approximately 55 staff, interns, and more than 100 volunteers. Safe & Sound headquarters is located in a historic firehouse in the Haight-Ashbury neighborhood of San Francisco, with a second office in the Bayview neighborhood.

More information is available at: .

**OVERALL SUMMARY**

The Senior Program Manager (SPM), Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs) provides strategic leadership for Safe & Sound’s role in San Francisco’s city-wide, multi-disciplinary teams that seek to advance system enhancement and improve the response to abused and exploited children. This is a leadership role, not a coordination role: the SPM sets direction, owns the data and the story it tells, leads the meetings, and drives the work forward between them, serving as a thought partner with agency partners and funders.

These teams include the Children’s Advocacy Center (CAC), the Working Group and Steering Committee for children and youth experiencing sexual exploitation (Commercial Sexual Exploitation of Children, CSEC), the Child Death Review Team (CDRT), and the Family Violence Council (FVC).

The SPM, MDTs holds an important role in implementing the department’s strategic direction. The SPM will work with external stakeholders and community and public partners to:

(1) enhance the coordinated, multidisciplinary approach to investigating child abuse allegations and providing trauma-informed services for victims of child abuse and exploitation;

(2) develop policies, protocols, procedures, and other data-informed solutions to improve complex systems challenges in the child abuse response structure;

(3) reduce re-victimization and the devastating long-term effects of child abuse and exploitation on children, their families, and society;

(4) increase coordinated case planning and service delivery for victims; and

(5) turn the patterns and learnings that surface across the teams into recommendations for practice, policy, and prevention.

The ideal candidate is familiar with child abuse, commercial sexual exploitation of children, and/or other areas of family violence, and with government systems and public policy. The position requires excellent project management and facilitation skills; strong written and verbal communication; experience in relationship-building and stakeholder engagement; strong analytical and organizational abilities; and the independence and initiative to identify what needs to happen, propose a plan with dates, and carry it through without step-by-step direction.

The position is a supervisory role that reports to the Chief Policy Officer, supervises the MDT Coordinator, collaborates with other SPP staff, receives strategic direction from the partners of the multi-disciplinary teams, and works frequently with representatives from San Francisco child welfare, law enforcement, public health, and other public and community agencies responding to family violence.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Strategic Leadership and Thought Partnership**

* Serve as a strategic thought partner to the Human Services Agency (HSA), other public funders, and partner agency leaders: learn what each partner needs from each team, bring ideas and options, and propose how the work can deliver more, rather than waiting for direction.
* Develop, with the CPO, a vision and annual priorities for each MDT, grounded in funder scopes of work, contract requirements, best practice, and partner input.
* Consolidate recommendations and patterns from the MDTs into actionable policy and practice changes that address barriers for children and youth interfacing with systems.
* Build structured learning into team meetings, such as reflection questions on what the group has learned and de-identified case briefs that partners can carry back to their leadership.
* Identify policy and legislative opportunities that emerge from MDT work and develop them with the CPO and the Senior Policy Advisor.

**Facilitation and Meeting Leadership**

* Own the agenda, preparation, facilitation (or co-facilitation where a partner agency facilitates), and follow-up for key MDT meetings and decision-making processes, so that Safe & Sound leads rather than supports.
* Establish and uphold group agreements so partners can examine what went wrong in a case or system without assigning blame.
* Disseminate information and materials, monitor logistics, and keep a running agenda and action-item tracker for each team.
* Ensure follow-up on action items so that team priorities move forward in a timely fashion.

**Family Violence Council, Data, and Research**

* Own Safe & Sound’s contribution to the Family Violence Council, including attending and preparing for council meeting

Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.  
  
We're 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.  
  
Come join us!

**About the Role**
------------------

This is a build role. You'll own the day-to-day growth of our strategic partners, anchored in the CRM Solutions Partner ecosystem (Salesforce, HubSpot, and similar), and help us diversify beyond it into resellers, MSPs, TSDs, and verticalized tech partners. Today a meaningful share of partner-sourced pipeline flows through a few tech integrations: real momentum, and real concentration risk.

You'll also help move our partner ecosystem from selling a phone system to earning influenced revenue and managed services around our AI products, including Voice Agents. You'll report to the Director, Channel Partnerships, work closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, AM, and RevOps, and get real executive exposure. This is an individual contributor role.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own strategic partner accounts.** Manage a portfolio of top-tier partners across our Solutions Partner tiers (Starter, Bronze, Silver, Gold), TSDs, and IT consultancies/MSPs, accountable for their partner-sourced pipeline and revenue.
* **Build joint GTM plans.** Set qualified pipeline, co-selling motions, and closed-revenue targets with each partner, and hold both sides to them.
* **Help diversify the channel.** Identify, evaluate, and onboard new partner types (resellers, MSPs, verticalized tech partners, e-commerce platforms, PE/VC networks, TSDs/Master Agents) so we rely less on a few integrations.
* **Grow influenced revenue and managed services.** Position our AI products as a bigger part of each partner's own revenue, not just another line item on their stack.
* **Enable and coach partners.** Run onboarding, training, and business reviews so partner teams can pitch and close confidently.
* **Drive AE and AM adoption.** Make the partner program easy to use for our own sellers and account managers: deal registration, co-sell, and referrals.
* **Run the channel by the numbers.** Own the partner scorecard, forecast with discipline, and use data (Partnerstack, Crossbeam, Salesforce) to spot gaps and close them.
* **Build executive relationships.** Represent Aircall with partner leadership at QBRs, conferences, and partner events.
* **Align across the business.** Bring partner insights to Sales, Marketing, Product, AM, and RevOps to keep the ecosystem tied to company GTM priorities.
* **Share what works.** Document playbooks and share best practices with the wider partnerships team.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 6+ years in channel partnerships or strategic partner management, with a track record of hitting partner-sourced revenue targets.
* Experience running joint business plans and co-selling with senior partner stakeholders.
* Someone who can operate at both altitudes: shape the plan, then get into the weeds of how it gets built.
* Hands-on fluency with Partnerstack, Crossbeam, and Salesforce.
* Strong sales fundamentals: forecast discipline, pipeline rigor, and deal coaching.
* A hands-on executor who runs the channel by the numbers and uses data to find and close gaps.
* Credibility with partner executives, and the ability to turn what you hear into program priorities across the business.
* Willingness to travel and build in-person relationships with partners and their customers.
* A collaborative, low-ego approach and clear written and verbal communication.
* **AI fluency:** comfortable using AI tools in your daily work and talking credibly with partners about AI products like Voice Agents.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* An existing network across platform ecosystems (Salesforce, HubSpot), IT consultancies/MSPs, TSDs, or PE/VC.
* Experience with managed-services or influenced-revenue partner models, ideally around AI or communications software.
* Experience in cloud communications, telecom, or CX software.
* Experience building partner playbooks and enablement content.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* Partner-sourced pipeline and partner-attached revenue.
* Net-new active partners, including new partner types beyond the CRM ecosystem.
* Referrals per partner.
* AE and AM adoption of the partner program.
* Joint business plan milestones and QBR cadence.
* Forecast accuracy and CRM and PRM data quality.  
    
  The base salary for this role is between $120 - $147K with an additional variable of $80 - $98K (60/40 split)  
  **$200,000 - $245,000 OTE**

**Why join us?**

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities

‍️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall

Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

Competitive salary package & benefits

  

**DE&I Statement:**

At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.

We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We're working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We're committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respect

jobs.title: Support Counselor - ECM (Lead Care Manager)
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
jobs.description:
**Lead Care Manager (ECM Support Counselor)**

Join our team as an ECM Support Counselor and take part in transforming the way Medi-Cal members with complex needs receive care and support.

As an ECM Support Counselor, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for Medi-Cal members enrolled in Enhanced Care Management (ECM). You will conduct outreach research across healthcare, community-based, and social-service settings throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to identify opportunities for connecting with and enrolling new client-members. You'll develop trusting relationships with members and provide comprehensive, individualized care management that addresses medical, behavioral health, and health-related social needs.

Working primarily in the community, you'll coordinate with health care providers, social service agencies, community organizations, and other members of the care team to ensure members receive the right services at the right time.

This is a full-time, benefited role with significant community-based work. The position requires flexibility to meet members where they live and receive services, including homes, health care settings, community centers, and other community locations. The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, has strong public speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with individuals or community groups, comfortable working in community-based settings, and culturally responsive and can support to individuals and families from diverse backgrounds.

  

**About Alternative Family Services**

Alternative Family Services is a Foster Family, Adoption and Mental Health Agency that has been serving abused and neglected children in our community since 1973. Our mission is to support vulnerable children and families in need of stability, safety, and well-being in communities. We provide a wide range of foster, adoption, mental health and transition-aged youth services in English and Spanish. We have eight locations throughout the Bay Area and over 200 employees. We celebrate diversity, equal opportunity, and excellence.

  

**Responsibilities and What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with community-based, social service, healthcare and other partner organizations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to increase awareness of ECM services and generate new client-member enrollment.
* Identify and engage with community-based, social-service or healthcare organizations to generate new client-member enrollment and strengthen community partnerships
* Plan, coordinate and participate in community outreach events to increase awareness and enrolment of ECM services, foster relationships with prospective clients, and generate new client-member enrollment
* Serve as the member’s primary point of contact, providing individualized and comprehensive care management; provide direct support services such as mentoring, skill-building, coaching, tutoring, and crisis response
* Develop person-centered care plans in partnership with members, their families or support systems, and the care team
* Meet with client-members in their homes and communities to assess needs, provide support, and help remove barriers to care
* Help client-members navigate health care and social service systems and connect them to appropriate providers and community resources across multiple systems
* Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure client-members successfully access recommended services
* Maintain regular communication with health plans, providers, community-based organizations, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team
* Advocate for members and help ensure their preferences, goals and needs remain central to their care
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in accordance with organizational, Medi-Cal, and health plan requirements
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy standards
* Monitor member progress and update care plans as needs and circumstances change
* Participate in care team meetings, case consultations, and other activities designed to improve coordination and outcomes
* Respond appropriately to urgent member needs and help connect members to crisis or emergency resources when necessary

  

**Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain fingerprint and government and Agency required background clearances
* CPR/First Aid certification
* Valid California driver’s license with an acceptable driving record, auto insurance showing as an insured driver on the policy and vehicle registration
* A bachelor’s degree in a social science related field; or an associate degree in a social science related field and have at least six months experience in working with emotionally disturbed children or children who have a serious behavioral problem; or at least two years of experience working with emotionally disturbed children or children who have a serious behavioral problem, and who demonstrate a combination of education, skills, and experience
* Experience providing case management, care coordination, social services, behavioral health services, health care services, or related support to individuals with complex needs
* Experience as an outreach coordinator and comfortability with public speaking
* Knowledge of county and community resources and the ability to connect members to social service programs
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience working with individuals experiencing complex medical, behavioral health, housing, food insecurity, or other social needs
* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with an interdisciplinary care team
* Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, cultural humility, and person-centered care
* Able to interact with co-workers, county representatives, and other treatment team members as part of a coop

jobs.title: Patient Services Assistant II (4723C), Herbert Wertheim School of Optometry and Vision Science #9005
jobs.description:
Patient Services Assistant II (4723C), Herbert Wertheim School of Optometry and Vision Science #9005 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Herbert Wertheim School of Optometry and Vision Science
  
  
Mission Statement Advancing optometric education, clinical practice, and vision research for the benefit of society. Vision Preeminence and leadership in optometric education, patient care, and vision science.
  
  
Values and Guiding Principles
  
  
At Berkeley Optometry and Vision Science, as part of a world-renowned university that embraces excellence and access, we foster an environment of trust and mutual respect, free expression and inquiry, and personal resilience and achievement. We demonstrate sensitivity and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds present in our community. These principles serve us daily in our reasoning and actions and aid us in our decision-making. The mission of the School is executed by approximately 20 ladder-rank faculty, 8 emeriti faculty, 133 full and part-time clinical faculty, 70 staff, 30 professional researchers, 20 graduate students, and 26 visiting faculty and postdoctoral research scholars. The staff includes professional, health care, technical, research, and clerical representation and provides support to a complex array of functions. We educate an estimated 320 students annually. Our O.D. program is a 4-year program with clinical training provided at 2 campus clinics, 10 satellite clinics (community care), 7 VA clinics, and 24 external clinics across the country. Our one-year post-graduate residency programs provide advanced clinical education in specialty areas of optometry to 18 residents with placement on and off-campus and our Vision Science program consists of 40 Ph.D. students. The Optometry Clinic provides comprehensive optical care services to the entire campus population and the general Bay Area community, with approximately 80,000 annual visits to Optometry Clinics at Minor Hall and the Tang Center. The Optometry Clinic is open 7 days per week and approximately 358 days per year.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Within the Herbert School of Optometry and Vision Science, the Assistant II serves as a key member of the front-line Patient Services team within the school's optometry clinics. They are the face of the optometry clinic and generally the first point of contact for all patients. This position may be assigned to work at any of the school's on and off campus optometry clinics, including the Tang Clinic at University Health Services, Meredith Morgan University Eye Center, or the clinic at the Emeryville Satellite campus. Within the school's various clinic locations, the Assistant II may be assigned to support any area of the clinic, including primary care, the specialty clinics, and the eyewear center.
  
  
This position is typically stationed at a reception desk for patient check in and check out, and is responsible for managing patient appointments, including scheduling and modifications; welcoming and directing patients to the appropriate clinic or waiting area; and providing general information.
  
  
Additional responsibilities include processing patient-related documentation, data entry into the electronic health systems, and assisting patients with contact lens and eyewear orders. The Assistant II is also responsible for verifying insurance coverage, securing authorizations for services, and collecting and recording patient payments.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is December 2, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Patient Appointment Activities - 50%
  
  
Triage patients to determine which clinic fits the patient care needs; request assistance from more experienced staff if in doubt.
  
Manage and resolve patient concerns in a professional, timely, and empathetic manner, escalating to management when necessary.
  
Schedule patient appointments on the electronic health records scheduling system according to patient, clinician or doctor request, following all correct procedures and entering all necessary information accurately.

jobs.description:
Astranis builds advanced satellites for high orbits, expanding humanity's reach into the solar system. Today Astranis satellites provide dedicated, secure networks to highly-sophisticated customers across the globe – large enterprises, sovereign governments, and the US military.

With five satellites on orbit and many more set to launch soon, the company is servicing a backlog of more than $1 billion of commercial contracts. Astranis is the preferred satellite communications partner for buyers with stringent requirements for uptime, data security, network visibility, and customization.

Astranis has raised over $1.2 billion from some of the world's best investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Baillie Gifford, Blackrock, Fidelity, Franklin Templeton, and Snowpoint, and employs a team of 500 engineers and entrepreneurs. Astranis designs, builds, and operates its satellites out of its 153,000 sq. ft. headquarters in Northern California, USA.

#### **AI Enablement & Learning and Development Partner**

Astranis is a fast-growing company where hardware, software, and operations teams ship on a tight schedule. The tools to work faster, especially AI tools, are already here. What we need now is someone to help every team use them well.

As our AI Enablement & Learning and Development Lead, you will own how Astranis learns. For your first three quarters, your focus is AI enablement: getting real, measurable adoption of the tools we already have. From there, you will broaden into a full learning and development function, including team-level onboarding, on-demand skills training, and a manager academy. You will be a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and runs programs yourself, with room to grow the function and, over time, scale into a leadership role.

You will report to the Director of Employee Success and sit on our AI Steering Committee.

#### **Role**

Execute on our AI Enablement Strategy (this is the focus for the first three quarters)

* 4 Pillars to this strategy:
* + Turn our existing AI training content (101 through 103) into a polished, formal curriculum with clear learning paths for different roles and skill levels.
  + Design and launch an AI for Managers course that gets team leads using these tools themselves and coaching their teams to do the same.
  + Coordinate company-wide hackathons twice a year, owning logistics, communications, judging, and follow-through so winning ideas turn into real workflow improvements.
  + Elevate our superuser community. Our best AI practitioners are already spread across the company and active in Slack; your job is to showcase their work through lunch and learns, workshops, and internal spotlights, and to make it easy for others to learn from them.
* Monitor key metrics like weekly average logins by team to evaluate progress and identify hotspots.
* Provide feedback to the AI Steering Committee, bringing usage data and employee feedback to inform decisions on tools and policy.

Formalize our learning and development function

* Partner with team leads to identify skill gaps and design team-level onboarding that gets new hires productive faster.
* Create targeted training on demand where teams need more support. (For example, a proposal writing workshop for teams responding to customer RFPs.)
* Build and launch a leadership academy program scoped for director-level leaders.
* Establish simple, repeatable ways to measure whether training works, and use what you learn to improve every program.
* Create lightweight systems, templates, and a knowledge base so learning scales beyond live sessions.
* Develop a framework to assess the feasibility and business case for an engineering rotational program, define program requirements and structure, and lead the design, development, and implementation of the program if approved.

#### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in learning and development, enablement, change management, or internal training, ideally at a fast-growing technology or engineering company.
* A track record of running adoption or enablement programs end to end and being able to show the results with data.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools. You use them regularly and can teach others to use them well, from complete beginners to power users.
* Strong instructional design and facilitation skills, in live workshops and in self-serve formats.
* Experience building or running internal communities, events, or hackathons.
* Comfort earning trust with highly technical employees and managers who are very busy.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to work independently, prioritize across many requests, and move quickly with limited process.

#### **Bonus**

* Experience launching a manager or leadership development program.
* Background supporting engineering, aerospace, or other deeply technical teams.
* Familiarity with learning platforms or LMS tools, and with analytics for tracking usage and engagement.
* Experience partnering with executives or a steering committee on technology rollouts.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
**About Bobyard**
-----------------

Construction is a multi-trillion-dollar industry facing a shortage of roughly 349,000 workers — and it still estimates by hand. Contractors spend weeks measuring and counting materials off drawings, and that caps how many jobs they can bid. Bobyard’s AI takes a contractor from a set of plans to a bid in minutes instead of weeks. Our customers run real construction jobs on Bobyard, not demos. We raised a $35M Series A led by 8VC, with Primary and Pear.

**Who We Are**

Builders. We ship real product to real contractors. If it doesn’t survive contact with a live job, it doesn’t count — we don’t do demo-ware.  
Owners. There’s no layer between you and the problem, and no permission slip required. When you see the solution, you own it, end to end.  
Independent minds. Strong convictions, open minds. We hire for how you think, not where you learned it — show us the work, not the résumé.  
Fast movers. We decide quickly and optimize for impact, not consensus. You’ll be judged by the people in the problem with you, on what you deliver.

**About the Role**

We are hiring an HR Generalist to own the operational backbone of People at Bobyard: payroll, benefits, leave, compliance, onboarding, offboarding, and HR systems. You will be our third Operations hire and second HR hire, reporting to our People lead and working closely with Finance, Talent, IT, and our outside vendors.

This is a hands-on role. You will run payroll, partner with vendors to register us in new states, support benefits, leave, and onboarding, and field the questions that land in our People inbox every day. You will also spot what is breaking as we grow and build the tracker, template, or workflow that fixes it.

You will thrive here if you love getting the details right, can juggle a lot of moving parts without dropping any, and bring warmth to every employee interaction while still holding clear boundaries.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Payroll and compensation operations**

* Process payroll across multiple schedules (bi-weekly and semi-monthly, global) in Rippling, including new hires, terminations, pay changes, commissions, and off-cycle runs.
* Review payroll for accuracy before approval and resolve employee pay questions.
* Partner with our outside accounting firm on payroll tax notices and state agency mail.

**Multi-state and international compliance**

* Partner with vendors to register Bobyard in new states as we hire there, and help keep our state accounts in good standing.
* Help maintain the employee handbook, state supplements, and required postings as laws change.
* Support wage and hour compliance, including exempt and non-exempt classification reviews.
* Manage I-9s, records retention, and audit-ready employee files.
* Track required training (harassment prevention, security awareness) and follow up until completion.

**Benefits and leave administration**

* Support benefits administration with our broker and providers, including enrollments, life events, and COBRA.
* Support open enrollment, from employee communications to post-enrollment audit.
* Support leaves of absence with our leave vendor, including state paid family leave claims and payroll top-up calculations.
* Be a friendly, plain-language answer to employee benefits and PTO questions.

**Onboarding and offboarding**

* Support the new hire experience from signed offer to Day 1: Rippling setup, paperwork, IT and equipment requests, calendars, and welcome communications, with a path to owning onboarding as you ramp.
* Help coordinate weekly start cohorts and their Day 1 and Week 1 schedules.
* Support offboarding, including final pay, benefits, access removal, equipment return, and required state notices.

**HR systems, data, and documents**

* Be our in-house Rippling expert: workflows, approvals, reporting, and clean employee data.
* Maintain the People team intake form and trackers, keeping requests moving and nothing dropped.
* Prepare employment change documents, such as offer, promotion, and change of status letters, for People lead approval.

**Vendors and special projects**

* Be a day-to-day contact for People vendors: payroll, benefits broker, 401(k), leave management, and immigration counsel.
* Support projects that keep a fast-growing company running, like address changes across agencies and policy rollouts.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must haves**

* 3 to 5 years of HR generalist or People Ops experience, ideally at a venture-backed startup.
* Hands-on, multi-state payroll experience, including California.
* Working knowledge of US employment law: wage and hour, leaves, final pay, and classification.
* Comfort administering benefits and leaves end to end.
* Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS, and confidence in spreadsheets.
* Sharp attention to detail. You double check the numbers before they go out.
* Clear, warm writing, and the discretion to handle sensitive information.
* A bias for action. You see a gap, propose a fix, and ship it.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience working with vendors to register a company in new states, or supporting employees in another country.
* Commission payroll experience.
* Experience working with a leave management vendor.
* PHR, SHRM-CP, or a similar certification.

**What we offer**

Cash for stability. Bonus for performance. Equity for ownership. Your package reflects your role, your experience, and what you deliver, and it grows as you do.

* $100,000–$120,000 base + bonus + 0.01%–0.03% equity (4-year vest)
* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4%
* Catered lunch in the office and $70 a month toward your commute
* Full-time, in person at our San Francisco office (101 2nd Street), 4 days a week.

Come build with us!

Come build with us!

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

**About us**
============

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.

We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. **Job:** You will support the operational core of People Ops at Parallel. That means running immigration coordination with outside counsel for roughly 30 visa holders and owning onboarding and offboarding for about 15 new hires a month. You’ll also keep benefits, payroll inputs and employee records in Rippling clean and ready for audit. You’ll be the first person employees come to with questions, and they’ll get fast, accurate answers. As headcount heads toward 150 and new regions come online, you’ll build international onboarding, run open enrollment and handle the logistics of our first performance cycle. You’ll report to the People Ops lead and own the operational side yourself, so they can focus on manager enablement and engagement.

You’ve managed H-1B, O-1 or E-3 cases alongside immigration counsel, and you know the timelines cold. You track dozens of moving pieces without dropping one, and you spot the broken step in a workflow the second time you run it. You can explain a benefits plan or a visa timeline in plain language. CRHC’s mission is to enhance healthcare services in Colorado by providing information, education, linkages, tools and energy toward addressing rural healthcare issues. By joining our dedicated team, you will be helping a diverse and inclusive statewide constituency of rural healthcare facilities and making an impact by improving access to quality healthcare in Colorado.

Our staff enjoy autonomy to do the work they do best, and you will too. Every day, you should finish your day knowing that you have made a positive difference!

Colorado Rural Health Center fosters a strength-based culture and focuses on developing your strengths as one of our top priorities. We strongly believe in continuous professional development and work to promote your growth through a variety of professional training resources and opportunities to attend events that cultivate professional development.

CRHC is an award-winning place of business, a certified Healthy Workplace, recognized for its culture of workplace and employee wellbeing.

CRHC offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, FSA, 401(k), Disability insurance, generous 20 PTO days initially with incremental increases in year 3, 5 & 9, plus 11 paid holidays per year, wellness program, and a variety of supplemental options including accident, ID theft and legal plans.

CRHC supports employee professional development by providing discretionary funding to employees to assist in their individual career growth.

CRHC is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we value an equitable and inclusive workplace and seek candidates with diverse backgrounds and abilities.

CRHC recognizes that many factors impact the health of individuals and communities, including geography, income, and race. We recognize the existence and power of historical and ongoing systematic structures that have excluded individuals from leading their most healthy lives. We are committed to repairing injustices by championing policies that recognize these inequities and foster community-led solutions. We are actively working to include diverse opinions and perspectives in our decision-making processes and advocacy work and recognize that we all live better lives when everyone has a seat at the table.

**If you are truly ready to make an impact on our rural healthcare landscape, we invite to you apply for the RHTP Program Coordinator by submitting your resume and cover letter on Indeed at:**

**https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Colorado-Rural-Health-Center/jobs**.

The salary range for this non-exempt position is $25 – $27 hourly and is commensurate with depth of experience and overall qualifications. CRHC is a Remote-First work environment. This position requires about 30% travel and is funded by HCPF through Rural Health Transformation Funding and is dependent upon that funding for continued employment. First year of the contract is through September 30, 2027, and employment beyond that date is dependent upon receipt of continued funding. Colorado is expected to receive CMS funding for RHTP for a total of five years.CRHC employees are required to be vaccinated against COVID-19.

**Company Description** EZRack supports growers and nurseries in shipping live plants to market with reduced cost, waste, and complexity. For over 25 years, the company has specialized in rack rental and recovery programs that keep green goods moving efficiently. EZRack operates more than 40 regional distribution centers, providing broad coverage and reliable logistics. These centers track and recover racks from over 10,000 garden centers and retail locations nationwide, offering a stable and scalable service environment for team members. This long-standing industry presence creates opportunities to collaborate with diverse customers and contribute to sustainable supply chain solutions.

**Role Description** The Account Manager is a full-time, remote position. This position is responsible for managing a portfolio of grower and nursery accounts, serving as the main point of contact for day-to-day communication. The Account Manager will handle order coordination, monitor rack rental and recovery activities, and ensure service levels meet customer expectations. Daily tasks include responding to inquiries, resolving issues, tracking account performance, and collaborating with operations and logistics teams to optimize rack utilization. The role also involves preparing reports, identifying opportunities for account growth, and supporting contract renewals and new business proposals. Success in this position requires strong relationship management skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through in a fast-paced, service-focused environment.

**Qualifications**

* Account management and customer relationship skills, including the ability to build trust, understand client needs, and provide proactive support.
* Experience with logistics, distribution, or supply chain coordination, ideally in an environment involving rentals, recovery programs, or multi-location service networks.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external partners.
* Solid organizational and time-management abilities, including managing multiple accounts, tracking details, and meeting deadlines.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and productivity tools (e.g., spreadsheets, presentation software, and reporting tools) to track accounts and analyze performance.
* Advanced Excel and data interpretation required.
* Problem-solving and analytical skills to identify service issues, interpret data, and recommend improvements for customer outcomes and operational efficiency.
* Prior experience in B2B services, horticulture, logistics, or related industries is beneficial but not required.
* Ability to work remote, and travel to customer locations, and adapt to changing priorities. 50% travel.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance
* Work from home

Experience:

* Microsoft Excel: 4 years (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Required)

Work Location: Remote

**We are seeking a Care Coordinator!**  
**Athens, OH**

***Join our Team!***

Integrated Services for Behavioral Health (ISBH) is a community-minded, forward-thinking behavioral health organization helping people along the road to health and well-being. We meet people in their homes and communities and help connect them to the resources. We serve Southeastern and Central Ohio with a comprehensive array of behavioral health and other services, working with local partners to promote healthy people and strong communities. Our services are intended to be collaborative and personalized for the individual.

OhioRISE is a Medicaid managed care program that provides specialized services for youth ages 0-20 with complex behavioral health and/or substance use needs.

  

The OhioRISE Care Coordinator is responsible for creating, planning, and organizing a team as defined by the family. This position facilitates child & family team meetings that support youth at home, in school, and in their communities with the goal of keeping families together and reducing hospitalizations. The team may include partnering with social service providers, community partners, and the families support systems. The care coordinators role includes leading the team in identifying needs, goals, and action steps to meet the families goals. The care coordinator ensures the youth and families have a voice and choice in all coordinated care and services provided.

***The pay range for this position is $20.19 - $25.03 per hour based on experience, education, and/or licensure.***

* Competitive salaries

* Excellent benefits

**Education:**

* Prior experience assisting members and/or providers with telephone inquiries

* Strong organizational, problem solving, communication, and interpersonal skills

$20.19 - $28.37

jobs.title: Project Manager, Whole Person Health
jobs.description:
#### **Job Title: Project Manager, Whole Person Health**

Location: Bethesda, Maryland (Remote)

Reports To: Director, Whole Person Health

FLSA Status: Exempt

Must be able to provide proof of residence in one of these states: KS, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, TN, TX, PA, VA, WA, WV, or DC

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Position Summary:**

The Project Manager, Whole Person Health is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of projects and initiatives in the Whole Person Health portfolio. This role will focus on the continuous improvement of NACHC's PRAPARE ® (Protocol for Responding to and Assessing Patients' Assets, Risks, and Experiences) portfolio.

This role requires strong project management and organizational skills in addition to working knowledge of whole-person screening assessments and healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, HL7® FHIR®, Gravity Project).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

1. Project and Portfolio Management

* Lead the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of assigned projects and strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate activities across crossfunctional teams, partners, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Monitor progress toward project goals, deliverables, and performance measures.
* Develop reports, presentations, and communications for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Conduct project reviews, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, contractual requirements, and operational expectations, as applicable.
* Support development and implementation of sustainable processes, resources, and tools that advance organizational priorities.

2. Health Center Engagement and Technical Assistance

* Provide technical assistance to health centers, PCAs, and HCCNs implementing PRAPARE® and social needs screening workflows.
* Support health center efforts to integrate PRAPARE® into electronic health records and care coordination processes.
* Facilitate peer learning opportunities focused on PRAPARE® implementation challenges and best practices.
* Respond to PRAPARE ®inquiries and provide ongoing support and resources to participating organizations.

3. Training, Education, and Learning Collaboratives

* Design and manage national learning collaboratives, webinars, workshops, and conference sessions related to PRAPARE® implementation.
* Develop educational materials, toolkits, implementation guides, and training curricula.
* Coordinate faculty, subject matter experts, and advisory groups supporting PRAPARE® initiatives.
* Facilitate virtual and inperson meetings focused on social needs screening and intervention strategies.
* Promote dissemination of promising practices and innovative health center models.

4. Data, Evaluation, and Quality Improvement

* Support collection, analysis, and interpretation of PRAPARE®related data and related interoperability standards. (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project)
* Support the development dashboards, reports, briefs, presentations, and infographics that communicate findings and impact.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen use of PRAPARE® data for population health management, quality improvement, and health equity initiatives.
* Support efforts related to data standardization, interoperability, and reporting requirements.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Development

* Build and maintain relationships with health centers, PCAs, HCCNs, federal agencies, health information technology partners, communitybased organizations, and national stakeholders.
* Represent NACHC at conferences, meetings, workgroups, and national forums.
* Support development of strategic partnerships that advance PRAPARE® adoption and sustainability.
* Engage external stakeholders in collaborative efforts to address whole person health and community wellbeing.

6. PRAPARE® Licensing and Stewardship

* Manage the administration and oversight of PRAPARE® licensing agreements, including onboarding, renewals, and stakeholder communications.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for organizations seeking to adopt, implement, or expand use of PRAPARE®.
* Maintain accurate licensing records, documentation, and tracking systems to support program operations and reporting.
* Coordinate licensing processes and ensure compliance with PRAPARE® usage requirements and organizational policies.
* Build and maintain relationships with licensed organizations and partners to support adoption, sustainability, and effective use of PRAPARE®.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Master's degree preferred in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Social Work, Public Policy, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be substituted for advanced education.
* Working knowledge of PRAPARE® and its application in community health center settings.
* Experience implementing or supporting PRAPARE within clinical, community health, or population health settings.
* Experience supporting implementation of screening, referral, care coordination, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Experience supporting wholeperson health screening, assessment, referral, and community resource connection programs
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project), and related interoperability standards.
* Experience working with electronic health records (EHRs), health information exchange, interoperability initiatives, or social needs data collection and reporting efforts.
* 10% travel to NACHC conferences and events.

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of experience in customer success, SaaS applications, account management, or technical support, including service to senior-level customer stakeholders
* Experience using Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM
* Strong project management skills, including experience coordinating implementation activities
* Excellent relationship-building and interpersonal skills, with the ability to establish trust and credibility with customers at multiple levels
* Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Computer Science, or a related field

Total Rewards:

Want to love where you work? Apply today to join us in ***work worth doing***!

The starting salary is anticipated between $85,000 and $100,000 and will be commensurate with experience.

Intrado is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Veterans/Disabled and Other Protected Categories. Our Company welcomes and encourages applications of individuals with disabilities. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. **An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.
* Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.
* Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.
* Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.
* Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.
* Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.
* Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.
* Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.
* Hands-on experience with a consumption- or usage-based business model, including how teams use consumption metrics across the customer lifecycle.
* Experience delivering internal tools with engineering teams, including writing scoped requirements and acceptance criteria and running user acceptance testing before release.
* Experience making build-versus-buy or consolidation decisions based on cost, return on investment, and business fit. You can reconcile competing requests from senior stakeholders and explain your decisions clearly.
* Experience shipping artificial intelligence agents or workflows people rely on, with the judgment to know where automation helps and where it adds complexity.
* Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.

Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.

**About the team**
------------------

Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. We're a globally distributed team that works asynchronously and partners with Revenue Operations, Revenue Strategy, Enablement, IT, and Engineering to support Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Ecosystem teams. We put decisions in writing and focus on making the tools easier for field teams to use.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About By the Pixel**

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

We support our clients end-to-end: strategy, design, custom development, hosting, tiered production support, SEO, paid advertising, and content marketing. Most of what we build is engineered from scratch, because a one-size-fits-all bundle rarely fits.

**How this role fits**

The Project Manager runs projects from scoping through delivery and manages ongoing retainer and support work, coordinating the internal team and keeping work on schedule and within its approved budget. You'll work closely with the Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and anything commercial, and with the Project Strategist, who owns what gets built and why on projects that have one.

**What you'll own**

**Project Planning & Scoping**

* Leads scoping and estimating for proposed and upcoming work, defining scope and deliverables with the project department leads and other subject matter experts on the team, and working from the goals and requirements the Project Strategist sets where one is assigned.
* Works with the Account Manager throughout scoping so estimates reflect the client's budget and commercial constraints.
* Updates estimates with department leads as requirements change during the project.
* Creates and maintains the project schedule, timeline, and plan, incorporating the client-side deadlines and contractual commitments the Account Manager supplies.
* Looks for ways to simplify how work is sequenced and structured, reducing the handoffs and dependencies that slow a project down.
* Decides when a project is better served by sprints than by a timeline-based structure, and runs them accordingly.

**Driving Progress**

* Plans and leads project kickoff meetings, ensuring the client and internal team are aligned on goals, roles, expectations, and next steps before work begins.
* Follows up on unclear requirements, pending decisions, and unresolved dependencies to prevent work from stalling, and brings in the Project Strategist for requirements questions when one is assigned.
* Tracks what the client and third-party vendors owe the project, such as content, assets, access, and approvals, and follows up when any of it is late.
* Identifies risks and blockers with the project team early, resolves them, and escalates any it cannot resolve to the Account Manager as soon as they arise.
* Monitors project progress daily and keeps the project team and Account Manager informed of status, upcoming milestones, and changes to timeline or scope.
* Tracks project budget and flags overages or scope changes to the Account Manager.
* Makes sure contributors log their time to the correct project and task, since budget tracking, time reports, and invoicing depend on it.
* Collects reports from department leads when time on a task exceeds expectations, and passes them to the Account Manager with enough context to decide what should be invoiced.
* Routes out-of-scope client requests to the Account Manager, and does not schedule or begin the work until the Account Manager has approved the additional budget.

**Team Coordination**

* Collaborates with the project department leads to delegate tasks based on each contributor's expertise, availability, and capacity.
* Gets contributors the information and resources they need to complete their work without delay.
* Coordinates handoffs between internal departments, running the meetings and communication each one needs.
* Identifies opportunities for ad hoc collaboration across the team, connecting contributors who can help each other even when they do not regularly work together.
* Works with Managers to build project teams that meet the needs of each engagement.

**Client Communication**

* Serves as the client's day-to-day contact for project schedules, status, and deliverables.
* Schedules and leads project and client meetings, preparing agendas, documenting outcomes, and following up on action items.
* Generates required project reports, including status updates, monthly summaries of work delivered, and weekly time reports.
* Sets expectations with clients on timelines and deliverables, and brings in the Account Manager before discussing any change that affects scope or budget.
* Schedules and coordinates client demos, which the relevant department lead runs.
* Runs client review rounds, setting the review schedule and feedback deadlines and collecting the client's feedback in one place for the Project Strategist or department leads to act on.
* Confirms each deliverable is complete, has passed department lead review and QA, and has the Project Strategist's sign-off where one is assigned before it reaches the client.

**Launch & Closeout**

* Plans each launch with the department leads, including the go-live checklist, launch timing, and who is available to support it.
* Confirms the Account Manager has the client's written acceptance of the final deliverables before closing the project.
* Closes out the project, resolving or reassigning any open tasks.
* Transitions the project to support or a retainer, documenting what was delivered and what remains open, and explaining to the client how to submit requests going forward.

**Retainers & Support Queues**

* Plans the work for each retainer period with the client and department leads, within the hours agreed with the client.
* Tracks retainer hours used against each period's allotment and tells the Account Manager when a client is on pace to go over or under.
* Triages incoming support requests by severity and assigns each to the appropriate contributor.
* Keeps the client updated on open support requests until each one is resolved.
* Escalates urgent production issues to the relevant department

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About EPIC iO Technologies**

EPIC iO builds technology for the real world.

We help organizations see more, know more, stay connected, and act faster by bringing together AI, intelligent video, edge technology, and enterprise-grade wireless connectivity.

But the technology is only part of the story.

What really makes EPIC iO different is the people behind it.

Smart, driven people who like solving hard problems. People who dig in, challenge assumptions, move quickly, and take ownership. People who know the best ideas can come from anywhere and that solving meaningful problems takes collaboration, curiosity, and zero ego.

We’re helping protect people and critical assets. Keep businesses and remote operations connected. Make existing infrastructure smarter. Turn real-world data into action when it matters most.

And we’re building a team that wants to make an impact while doing it.

Wicked-smart people. Real-world problems. Technology that matters. And we’re just getting started.

The Project Manager supports Customer Operations by managing customer projects from initiation through completion. **Responsibilities & Tasks**

* Track risks, actions, issues, and dependencies using a consistent approach and communicate impacts, mitigations, owners, and due dates.

* Monitor project progress against defined success criteria and escalate variances, delays, blockers, or customer-impacting issues in a timely manner.
* Support resource and event tracking and prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, or ad-hoc reporting as required by leadership or customer needs.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders by phone, email, meetings, and project updates.
* Identify and quantify project variances, recommend corrective actions, and track follow-through to support project delivery outcomes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with ability to influence and interact credibly at multiple organizational levels.

* Ability to manage daily workflow with limited supervision while meeting departmental and customer requirements.
* Experience managing projects in an ERP, project management, or comparable business system.

* Hands-on experience delivering projects in telecommunications, wireless, or fiber environments.
* Demonstrated experience managing IT infrastructure projects such as server replacement or refresh, network deployments, and unified communications (UCaaS) implementations.

**Desired Qualifications**

* PMP certification preferred; equivalent project management certification or formal training considered.
* Experience with technology deployments, customer operations, field services, or multi-workstream implementation projects.
* Experience using Monday.com, ERP tools, CRM systems, or comparable project/work management platforms.
* Background with an enterprise technology manufacturer, systems integrator, VAR, or managed services provider delivering infrastructure, networking, or communications projects for business customers.

**Physical Requirements**

* Prolonged periods of sitting and working on a computer.
* Ability to communicate effectively by phone, email, video, and online collaboration tools in a remote environment.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

***Equal Employment Opportunity***

EPIC iO is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. The Company does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. The Project Manager will identify, design, build, and scale AI-enabled workflows (such as automated status reporting, onboarding playbooks, meeting capture, and task tracking) that make NPL and OnRamp delivery faster, more consistent, and easier to scale as partner volume grows.

* Serves as the key facilitator between project teams, cross-functional departments, external vendors, and partners; leads project meetings, documents decisions and action items, and keeps stakeholders aligned on goals, deliverables, and timelines

jobs.title: Customer Organization Program Manager
jobs.description:
*\*An internal or pre-identified candidate is currently under consideration, but all qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.*

  

**Customer Organization Program Manager**

  

Join Epicor as a Program manager! The Customer Organization Program Manager owns the development of Epicor's FY27 sales plays from strategy to enablement. You will turn identified sales plays into playbooks, content and training that help sellers lead with business outcomes, not features.

  

You'll sit at the center of Sales, Product Marketing and Demand Generation. You'll build the programs and hand-offs that connect them, so every launch, campaign and training lands as one cohesive story for sellers and customers. This is a new role on a growing Revenue Enablement team, with the ability to influence how Epicor goes to market.

  

**What you will be doing**

  

**Own the sales plays**

  

* Build and maintain a playbook for each FY27 sales play: target personas (CFO, COO, CIO, CXO), verticals, discovery questions, value messages, proof points, objection handling and competitive positioning.

* Identify the content each play needs at each sales stage, audit what exists, and fill the gaps.

* Coordinate content development between Sales, Product Marketing and SMEs, managing timelines, owners and approvals.

* Coordinate rollout and training for each play alongside enablement lead, from launch sessions to manager coaching guides and reinforcement.

Run the rolling 2-quarter enablement roadmap with Product Marketing, so product launches are packaged into play-based training.  

  

**Strengthen the Marketing–Sales partnership**

  

* Design programs and clear hand-offs between Demand Generation, Product Marketing and Sales, from MQL to SAL through to Discovery.

* Act as stakeholder from Sales on Insight conference development and delivery.

* Align campaign messaging with sales plays so sellers can follow up on what marketing starts.

Set up feedback loops with sellers and sales leaders and bring field insight back to Marketing and Product.  

  

**Activate plays in market**

  

* Work with Marketing and regional sales leaders on market activation: campaigns, events, account-based programs and partner motions tied to each play.

* Work with enablement lead to select the right format for each audience and moment, such as live sessions, microlearning, play kits, battlecards, talk tracks, demo stories and digital sales rooms.

Write clear, compelling seller-facing communications for launches, play updates and program news.  

  

**Measure and improve**

  

* Define and report success measures for each play: adoption, content usage, pipeline created and win rate in the target segment.

Use the data to refine plays, retire content that isn't working, and prioritize what comes next.  

  

**Other enablement projects**

  

* Support broader Customer Organization strategic initiatives, including leader programs, sales kickoffs, onboarding and tools rollouts, and others as assigned.

Support with Chief of Staff duties as assigned.  

  

**What you will likely bring**

  

* 10+ years of experience across sales enablement, product or solution marketing, sales programs, or marketing communications in B2B technology. Experience in an ERP organization or similar complex SaaS is required.

* A track record of building sales plays, playbooks or go-to-market programs that sellers actually use.

* Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn complex product capabilities into clear business outcome and value messages.

* Program management discipline: you can run multiple workstreams, timelines and stakeholders at once and keep them on track.

* Experience influencing without authority across Sales, Marketing and Product, including with senior leaders.

* Comfort designing and delivering training, both live and virtual, to sales audiences.

* An analytical mindset, with experience using CRM and enablement data to measure impact.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Background in communications or PR, especially message development, internal communications or change communications.

* Experience with ERP, supply chain or industry software sold to manufacturing, distribution, retail, automotive or building supply businesses.

* Familiarity with value selling, MEDDICC, Challenger or similar sales methodologies.

* Hands-on experience with tools such as Salesforce, Gong, Highspot, Seismic or an LMS.

* Experience with account-based marketing, demand generation programs or partner enablement.

* Experience using AI tools to speed up content creation, research or enablement delivery.

Prior experience leading or mentoring others, or a desire to build a team.  

  

**What success looks like in your first year**

  

* **First 60 days:** Learn the four plays, sellers and stakeholders. Audit existing content against each play, and build first sales play.

* **By 6 months:** Launch complete playbooks for at least three plays, with training delivered to Account Executives/TMs and CAMs, and an agreed Marketing-to-Sales hand-off process.

* **By 12 months:** All four plays are live and refreshed quarterly. Fewer standalone feature trainings reach sellers, and play adoption and pipeline impact are reported to leadership each quarter.

Work from home, and on the road. Monday – Friday, regular business hours.

As a Medical Case Manager you will make a meaningful difference in the lives of injured workers and their families. Your responsibilities include working closely with injured workers to facilitate their recovery. You will work collaboratively with the patient, their family, medical providers, members of our team, and others. This is a heavy local travel role responsible for working with a caseload of workers compensation injured workers within a defined jurisdiction.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ability to meet with the patient, their physicians, other healthcare providers, attorneys, advisors/clients, and coworkers

**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:**
