jobs.title: Enablement Program Manager
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Enablement Program Manager to build and scale central enablement programs for a fast-moving sales organization. You'll own onboarding for new sales hires and ongoing upskilling for current teams. That covers the full cycle: creating content, scheduling and delivering training, then tracking readiness and acting on the results. You'll work with field leaders, regional enablement teams, Sales Operations, and subject matter experts. Your programs will reach new-hire cohorts of up to 20 people and wider initiatives covering 100 to 400 sales reps across new business acquisition and account management.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Own the design, execution, and continuous improvement of central enablement programs that regional teams can adapt to local needs.
* Manage program roadmaps, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communications, prioritizing by field needs and business impact.
* Build and run role-based onboarding journeys for new sales hires, including learning paths, live sessions, practice exercises, and readiness assessments.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and cross-functional partners to create content, set training schedules, and run cohorts end to end, with clear milestones and manager guidance.
* Deliver parts of the training yourself as projects require.
* Build ongoing upskilling programs in discovery, value-based pitching, objection handling, closing, and account growth.
* Turn sales motions and methodologies into playbooks, talk tracks, talking points, collateral, mock calls, and certifications.
* Spot areas of low readiness and build refresher training and targeted improvement plans with stakeholders.
* Partner with sales managers to reinforce learning through coaching guides, practice, and follow-up activities.
* Develop and maintain eLearning, facilitator guides, quick reference guides, short videos, and toolkits, and keep content current and easy to find in Highspot.
* Work with tools and process owners to build workflow and process changes into onboarding and upskilling programs.
* Define and track program metrics, including training completion, call certification quality scores, ramp readiness against sales goals, and learner surveys. Report progress and recommendations to stakeholders.

### **Qualifications**

**Required**

* 7+ years in enablement, learning and development, sales operations, or a related program management role supporting sales teams. Candidates from a similar fast-paced, high-growth tech environment will be considered with 5+ years.
* Deep enablement expertise from start to finish (content creation, delivery, and metrics tracking). Sales enablement experience is strongly preferred.
* A track record of building and running onboarding and upskilling programs, from needs assessment through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
* Hands-on experience creating training content and running engaging sessions for adult learners. This is a hands-on role, not a purely managerial one.
* Hands-on experience with sales enablement platforms, ideally Highspot (Seismic or comparable platforms considered), plus Gong and course authoring tools such as Articulate 360.
* Working knowledge of sales motions, methodologies, sales cycles, and performance metrics such as readiness, ramp, and certification quality scores.
* Strong program management and operational rigor. You can juggle multiple priorities and deliver independently in a fast-changing environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to align cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* Comfort using data to define program metrics and judge program effectiveness. Familiarity with Salesforce and learning or content management platforms.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, PowerPoint, Excel, Slack, and Asana, Airtable, or similar tools.
* Fluency with AI tools in your workflow, with sound judgment on top.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting global teams and adapting central programs for different regions and sales roles.
* Experience with Synthesia or other AI-assisted content tools, used with good quality control.
* Experience in a marketplace, travel, hospitality, or technology business.
* Work samples or a content portfolio to share during interviews.

### **Key Details**

* **Start date:** December 2026 (ASAP)
* **Duration:** About 5-6 months, with possible extension based on performance
* **Location:** Remote (within the U.S.)
* **Work schedule:** Full-time, 40 hours/week, Monday-Friday, on Pacific or Eastern time zone hours
* **Pay rate range:** $65-$72/hour
* **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.
* **Engagement:** W-2 Contract

jobs.title: Uniti Fiber - Manager-Sales Enablement
jobs.description:
Uniti is a premier insurgent fiber provider dedicated to enabling mission-critical connectivity across the United States.
  
  
With a steadfast commitment to customer service, operational excellence, and superior network capabilities, Uniti builds, operates and delivers critical fiber-based communications services to connect and empower people and businesses.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
About the Role
  
Lead sales enablement strategy and execution for Enterprise and Mid-Market, ensuring sellers and customer-facing teams can confidently translate product, brand, and campaign strategies into relevant customer conversations and effective sales motions.
  
Create and maintain the collateral, tools, training, playbooks, programs, and communications required to improve seller readiness, consistency, adoption, and productivity. Carry initiatives from needs assessment and design through launch, reinforcement, measurement, and continuous improvement.
  
Partner across Sales Leadership, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Product, Sales Operations, Learning and Development, Digital, Internal Communications, and Creative Services to align enablement with business priorities and frontline realities.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
Enablement Strategy & Planning
  

* Segment enablement strategy: Build enablement plans aligned to Enterprise and Mid-Market sales motions, roles, customer needs, products, campaigns, and growth priorities.
* Needs assessment: Use seller feedback, performance data, customer insights, launch plans, and leadership priorities to identify readiness gaps and focus resources.
* Enablement roadmap: Manage a prioritized roadmap and calendar connecting launches, campaigns, seasonal programs, sales meetings, tools, and training.
* Cross-functional governance: Create clear intake, development, approval, launch, maintenance, and retirement processes for enablement materials and programs.

Content, Tools & Training
  

* Collateral and tools: Develop and govern customer-facing and seller-facing collateral, presentations, battlecards, discovery guides, talk tracks, proposal content, and digital tools.
* Playbooks: Build practical playbooks for priority products, segments, use cases, campaigns, competitors, cross-sell motions, and account-development opportunities.
* Training and readiness: Design and facilitate training that builds knowledge, confidence, skills, and application, using reinforcement and manager support to sustain adoption.
* Launch enablement: Translate GTM strategy into seller-ready materials, training, FAQs, objection handling, proof points, and launch communications.
* Sales kickoffs and communications: Lead enablement for sales kickoffs, launches, recurring sales forums, and internal social or communications streams such as Uconnect.

Sales Programs & Adoption
  

* Referral programs: Design and support referral motions with clear eligibility, messaging, tools, handoffs, tracking, and field communications.
* Incentives and recognition: Partner with Sales Leadership, Finance, HR, and Operations on targeted incentives and recognition programs, including major recognition experiences such as President’s Club where assigned.
* Adoption and reinforcement: Drive usage of approved messaging, collateral, tools, and processes through manager reinforcement, communications, office hours, and field feedback loops.
* Performance measurement: Measure participation, completion, adoption, seller confidence, content use, funnel behavior, and business impact; use findings to improve programs.

jobs.description:

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

**Customer Success Manager, Accounts & Retention**  
  
**About the Role**  
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you own a book of higher ed accounts from the welcome meeting through every renewal. You're the customer's main contact at Kuali and the person who knows their goals, their people, and how they actually use our products. You also own the renewal, so retention and growth in your book are yours to drive.  
  
This is an account management role. Product owns the roadmap and decides what gets built. Your part is to understand what each customer needs, bring that context to Product through our intake process, and keep the customer posted on what happens next. You don't need to know the roadmap by heart, and you won't be asked to make feature commitments.  
  
You also won't have every answer, especially in your first months. Customers will ask about integrations, data, and edge cases you haven't seen before. We want someone who's at ease saying they'll check, knows who to ask inside Kuali, and closes the loop with the customer quickly.  
  
The job is part relationship work and part operations. You'll spend time on calls and on campus, and you'll also work in Salesforce and ChurnZero tracking health scores, renewal dates, and next steps. You'll partner with Sales, Implementation, Support, and Product, and you'll bring the customer's view into each of those conversations.

**Who are we?**

Kuali builds software for colleges and universities. Our products cover forms and workflow (Build), emergency and continuity planning (Ready), curriculum and student systems (Student), research administration (Research), financials, and student outreach (Reach).Campus teams use Kuali to run work that used to live in paper, email, and spreadsheets.

Our Customer Success team owns the relationship with every customer after the contract is signed. We're growing that team and building out how we work with accounts, so you'll have a real say in the playbooks, metrics, and habits we settle on.

**Our Culture**  
As a company, we are guided by our cultural values:

* Iterate to evolve
* Cultivate openness
* Act with accountability
* Assume the best
* Practice humility

We work remotely, and have for years. Distributed work is in our bones, with a history of institutions working across state lines on open-source software for more than ten years. Our employees each work in the environment where they’re happiest, from Pennsylvania to Seattle. We work consciously to create a collaborative and healthy remote work culture, and we travel to meet in person a few times each year. We feel it’s important for employees to come to work refreshed and ready for the week so we have a four day work week policy, Monday-Thursday.

  
**Everyone should love their work.**

**About you**

* **You align with Kuali’s values:** You are excited to contribute to an environment that reflects them.
* **You are detail-oriented:** You have an amazing attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
* **You are an amazing communicator:** You are a great listener and communication is clear, concise, and tailored to your audience. You possess strong editing skills.
* **You are organized, communicative, and accountable:** You possess excellent organization and prioritization skills. You own your role entirely, while being open to feedback, suggestions, edits, and new ideas.
* **You are self-motivated and eager to grow:** You have a thirst for knowledge especially within higher education. You are proactive and your enthusiasm shows.
* **You are resourceful and solution-oriented:** When you're faced with a problem, you work to solve it with tact, persistence, and urgency.
* **You are Resourceful:** You have the ability to conduct research and synthesize information from multiple sources (subject matter experts, previous proposals) into a cohesive, easy-to-read, and persuasive final product. You are good at adapting to various people and personalities.
* **You are able to multitask effectively:** You are good at working on multiple concurrent projects that sometimes have short turn-around times.
* **You are team oriented and set up for success on a remote team:** You love being helpful and supportive and thrive on the successes of the team. You’re comfortable being part of a fully remote team, and you have a suitable home working environment or alternative.

**What you’ll be responsible for**  
  
**Account ownership and renewals**

* Own gross and net revenue retention for your book of business.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Expansion
jobs.description:
UserGems is an AI platform that helps sales and marketing teams double their pipeline impact with the same team. Our AI agent (Gem-E) captures buying signals and your CRM data to identify who to target, when, and why, drafting highly personalized and impactful outreach that results in higher conversion.

UserGems has generated $4 billion in pipeline and over $950 million in revenue for hundreds of start-ups and public companies. Companies like Mimecast, UserTesting, SAP LeanIX see more than 15X ROI in closed-won revenue from UserGems.

We are looking for an Account Manager to own expansion inside a defined book of commercial accounts. The goal of the AM is to create and close incremental expansion revenue through disciplined internal prospecting, tight partnership with Customer Success, and a consistent close process.

This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a high-growth environment and is self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit.

**As an Account Manager, you will:**

* Consistently create pipeline from whitespace, not just from support tickets or inbound asks
* Run 10–15 active expansion cycles at once without losing control of next steps
* Build at least two champions in priority accounts and multi-thread to power.
Hit or exceed your incremental expansion target while improving team processes  

**Drive proactive expansion pipeline**

* Identify opportunities in existing accounts: departments, teams, personas, and use cases not currently covered
* Run internal prospecting: stakeholder mapping, outreach, discovery, and multi-threading to build champions and executive alignment
* Create clear value hypotheses tied to customer outcomes (not feature pitches)

**Own commercial execution**

* Lead expansion discovery, qualification, close plans, and negotiation for upsells/cross-sells within your book.
* Maintain accurate forecasting and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce
* Coordinate internal resources (CSM, Product, Leadership) to advance deals

**Partner deeply with Customer Success**

* Operate as the commercial counterpart to the CSM: CS owns adoption/health; you own expansion pipeline and closes
* Run joint account planning, QBR prep, and quarterly whitespace reviews

**How you'll ramp:**

...within your first week...

* Shadow your first expansion deal
* Learn about our product + customer segments
* Meet your colleagues on the CSM and AM team

...day 30...

* Get hands on with the product yourself
* Complete stakeholder maps and expansion hypotheses for top 25 accounts
* Establish operating cadence with CSMs; baseline your book (usage, adoption, renewal timing)
* Start building pipeline by week 3

...day 60...

* Consistent outbound motion underway
* Multiple opportunities in mid/late stages; aim for first closed-won expansion(s)

**What you've accomplished so far:**

* 3-5 years of quota-carrying experience in B2B SaaS with a strong track record in expansion / existing customer growth
* You have a firm grasp on SaaS sales best practices
* Strong discovery + value framing skills: can tie outcomes to business impact and run a clean close plan
* Highly organized with strong CRM discipline and forecasting
* You are comfortable with internal prospecting: mapping accounts, finding new stakeholders, and creating opportunities (not just taking inbound)
* You’ve become a trusted resource for your prospects, customers, and teammates
* You are an excellent cross-functional partner: you thrive working with CS, Product, and leadership teams to move accounts forward
* You are comfortable leading “business value” and “ROI” conversations
* Willing to become a technical expert yourself without relying on a dedicated Solutions Engineer

**Why you should join:**

* You’ll be part of a fast-growing startup as it scales from 70 to 100 employees
* Customers love us and there are plenty of opportunities for expansion! (see our Customers page and G2 Reviews)
* We're a remote-first company with employees across the Americas and Europe
* We have Weekly Standups, virtual celebrations, and in-person off-sites around the world so that everyone stays connected
* We believe strongly in being customer-focused and data-driven in everything we do
* We value individual differences in the workforce and strive to make everyone feel welcomed and accepted, regardless of their skin color, gender or sexual orientation
* We offer a competitive salary and benefits

Compensation range: $144,000–$168,000 annual OTE (50/50 base/ variable split). Final compensation package will be determined based on commensurate experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability to perform in the role.

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

**About the Team**

The Forward Deployment Strategy & Operations team closely partners with GTM leadership and Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) to help organizations move from AI ambition to durable production outcomes. We combine technical depth, deployment expertise, and commercial and operational discipline to solve complex problems in customer environments and accelerate adoption of OpenAI’s models and products.

* A low-ego, high-ownership working style, comfort with rapid change, and genuine interest in how frontier AI can create durable customer value.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive expertise in e-commerce operations, digital marketplaces, inventory management, international trade, and supply chain optimization. * Experience with automation, AI-enabled analytics, or digital commerce transformation is an asset.

* Opportunity to lead strategic e-commerce operations and digital business expansion.
* Collaborative environment combining international trading, technology, and online retail management.
* Exposure to digital marketplaces, supply chain technologies, and e-commerce automation.
* Opportunities for senior leadership development and professional advancement.
* Ability to influence operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and business profitability.
* Competitive senior-management compensation and performance-based incentives.

Premium Nep International Trading & Business Solutions LLC is positioned as an international trading and business solutions company focused on digital commerce, global sourcing, online retail operations, and business process optimization.

Using a multi-disciplined team approach, the program provides street and venue-based outreach and engagement, assessment, health services and triage, case management, as well as linkages to housing agencies and mental health services. The program will work with all participants to develop and carry out action plans that improve health and wellness.

Under the supervision of the Director of Population Health, the **Street Health Outreach Community Health Worker** will work directly with participants to access housing programs, assist with enrollment and/or maintenance of Medi-Cal or HealthPAC, and provide navigational support to successfully engage participants to a medical home. Other activities include health education, care plan development, public benefit linkage and assisting the participant with accessing TVHC health care services.

**Schedule:** This is a full-time position, working 40 hours per week, typically Monday through Friday, with occasional Saturday hours.

**About TVHC:** Tiburcio Vasquez Health Center is a nonprofit community health center dedicated to promoting the health and well-being of our community by providing accessible, high-quality care through the integration of primary care, dental care, WIC support, mental health counseling, community health education, and more.

**Benefits:** We offer excellent benefits, including: medical (100% paid co-payments, premiums, etc.), dental, vision (including dependent and domestic partner coverage), generous paid leave benefits including holidays, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement plans with an Employer match, tuition reimbursement, monthly treats, pet insurance, and more.

\*As position is grant-funded, employment is subject to the availability of grant funding\*

**Compensation:** $24.00 - $26.00 per hour, depending on experience.

*This position is represented by SEIU, with compensation and benefits determined by the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). Salary is based on the wage scales outlined in the agreement. Beyond base pay, TVHC provides a comprehensive compensation package that supports the health, wealth, and career development of our employees.*

**Responsibilities:**

* Engages, empowers and advocates for Alameda County unsheltered residents and helps them achieve their best health.
* Conducts regular street outreach and engagement, building trust with individuals encountered at encampments and other service locations according to the responsive schedule.
* Attends to immediate survival needs as prioritized by clients, e.g. distributing basic necessities and supplies.
* Provides problem-solving support using Motivational Interviewing techniques.
* Creates a care plan that reflects the client’s need based on outreach assessment.
* Coordinates linkages to various community resources to meet these needs and works from an interdisciplinary approach.
* Provides case management services in a culturally, linguistically and age appropriate manner.
* Serves as a liaison between the client, community and health and social services.
* Assists clients with enrollment and maintenance of MediCal and Medicare eligibility as well as with other benefits such as CalFresh, GA and SSI.
* Provides culturally competent, trauma informed health services.
* Maintains client information and case documentation in a confidential and professional manner.
* Completes Coordinated Enrry Assessments for individuals seeking housing.
* Maintains client data and responsible for updating county database on a monthly basis.
* Adheres to organizational policy and procedures.
* Builds and maintains appropriate relationships with staff, encampment leaders and Housing Resource Centers.
* Supports a positive work environment and fosters teamwork.
* Represents Street Outreach team at county and community based organization events and meetings.
* Participates with other staff in multidisciplinary meetings and other staff processes to achieve program development, staff development, program evaluation, program operations review, and other activities as appropriate.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and expectations required of the position.*

Requirements:

* High school diploma, or equivalent required.
* BLS certification required.

**Qualifications:**

* Associate of Arts Degree preferred.
* Minimum of one (1) year experience providing outreach to chronically unhoused individuals preferred.
* Experience with Electronic Medical Records (EHR) preferred.
* Bilingual; English/Spanish preferred.
* Lived experience of homelessness valued.
* Be highly dependable and independent.
* Good communication; ability to work well within a team and independently.
* Proficiency in computer operations, navigational skills and comfortable with Internet-based applications.
* Sound decision-making skills including problem solving.
* Professional demeanor.
* Sensitivity to and understanding of the special needs of unsheltered people facing complex challenges.
* Excellent communication, organizational and time management skills with the ability to meet tight timeframes.
* Strong understanding of the health care and community resources.
* Must be willing to travel to assigned locations and drive street health medicine van to and from various service sites as needed.
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively.
* Flexible and adaptable to change.
* Ability to learn quickly and retain complex information.
* Ability to travel to work assignments.

Google's leadership team hand-picks thorny business challenges, and members of BizOps work in small teams to find solutions. * Lead the fund’s executive cadence of business, driving quarterly strategic reviews, executive syncs, and leadership alignment across Google Labs, DeepMind, and Google Cloud.

Finance - San Francisco

**About the Team**

The Transformation team at OpenAI partners with Finance, Infrastructure, Data, and Engineering to design and scale the business processes and systems that support our growth. Our work combines process design, systems thinking, and operational change to turn fragmented workflows into reliable, repeatable, and well-controlled operations.

We work as embedded partners to Finance, Accounting, and Operations, shaping priorities and delivering improvements across core business processes. For Infra, our focus is on providing tooling for visibility across the life cycle of data center infrastructure that feeds accurate accounting and finance records. For compute, our focus is an accurate, connected view of contractual obligations, delivered capacity, usage, and cost that supports sound decisions and repeatable financial operations.

**About the Role**

As Program Manageration, you will lead cross-functional initiatives that connect purchasing, construction, operations, billing, accounting, and financial planning across our compute commitments and our data center initiatives. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with ownership of problem definition, process design, integrated planning, and end-to-end delivery.

You will work across Compute Finance, Infrastructure Accounting, Capacity Planning, Fleet, Design & Construction, Operations, Procurement, Legal, Data, and Engineering. You will turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, drive decisions and dependencies, and deliver reliable processes and systems that make compute and infra spend easier to understand, forecast, reconcile, and control.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with a hybrid work model of 3 days per week in the office.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own an integrated compute and infra transformation plan: workstreams, milestones, critical dependencies, resources, decision logs, and acceptance criteria. Drive execution from problem definition through production adoption.
* Map current workflows and design scalable processes from demand planning, contracting, delivery & acceptance, receiving & operations, invoicing, payment, and month-end close. Clarify ownership, handoffs, evidence, and exception paths.
* Enable source of truth systems that cover both operational needs and accounting / finance needs for data center construction, operations, and maintenance.
* Drive consistent tracking of contracts, tranches, delivery events, and capacity acceptance. Connect committed spend to provisioned, accepted, allocated, and used capacity to support forecasting and financial review.
* Coordinate reliable ingestion and normalization of cloud service provider usage, billing, invoice, and delivery data. Establish data owners, completeness checks, and traceability to financial outputs.
* Improve compute billing, accrual, and allocation processes through consistent pricing rules, SKU mappings, telemetry and organizational tags, reconciliations, and controlled handling of manual adjustments.
* Partner with applications, with monitoring and governed change controls.
* Align Infrastructure, Finance, Accounting, Procurement, Legal, and Engineering on decisions and dependencies. Manage scope, risks, vendor dependencies, and change requests; escalate with clear options and business impact.
* Lead end-to-end testing, UAT, rollout, training, and handoff to operational owners. Define success measures for traceability, data quality, manual effort, exception resolution, close readiness, and adoption.

**You might thrive in this role if you have:**

* 8+ years of experience in project or program managementation, infrastructure operations, or enterprise systems delivery in complex, scaled environments.
* Understanding of compute or infrastructure economics and related finance processes, including commitments, usage-based billing, procurement, accruals, cost allocation, and forecasting.
* Experience partnering with software and data engineers to define requirements, resolve tradeoffs, test solutions, and deliver changes into production without direct authority.
* A strong process mindset and the ability to connect contractual terms, operational events, financial data, and control requirements into a practical future-state design.
* Fluency in data dependenciess.
* Experience improving workflows through automation or AI, with appropriate human review, controls, exception handling, and operational ownership.
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive updates that explain decisions, risks, business impact, and specific actions needed.
* Experience driving complex initiatives through ambiguity and organizational change, with clear evidence of hands-on delivery and adoption. Cloud FinOps, infrastructure finance, or capacity-planning experience is a strong plus.

**About the Role**  
  
Uber is looking for a Senior Program Manager, Tech (L5) to lead LLM quality and evaluation programs across multilingual products and AI-powered experiences. You will define how we measure model quality, identify failures, and determine whether AI solutions are ready for production.  
  
Working across Engineering, LLMOps within the Localization Technology team, Multilingual Program manager, Product, and vendors, you will build, assess or improve the existing evaluation frameworks that validate model performance by language, market, content type, cultural nuance, and audiences. This role requires strong technical fluency in LLM behavior, understanding NLP, and the program leadership to turn evaluation findings into measurable improvements.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* **Own the LLM quality and evaluation roadmap.** Define program goals, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and release criteria across models and use cases.
* **Build scalable evaluation frameworks.** Establish statistically defensible methods to assess accuracy such as recall and precision, relevance, completeness, instruction following, linguistic quality, and cultural appropriateness.
* **Develop high-quality evaluation datasets.** Lead the creation, annotation, adjudication, versioning, and maintenance of golden datasets that represent real user needs, challenging scenarios, and multilingual requirements.
* **Evaluate model and system failures.** Partner with technical teams to assess hallucinations, prompt-injection susceptibility, unsupported claims, context loss, and inconsistent outputs. Evaluate retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for retrieval relevance, groundedness, and citation accuracy.
* **Lead human and automated evaluation.** Establish reviewer guidelines, calibrate LLM-as-a-judge systems against expert assessments, and measure agreement, false positives, false negatives, and severity classification.
* **Drive model fitness decisions.** Collaborating with LLMOpn in the Localization Technology team to compare models and configurations by locale, task, quality, cost, and latency to inform model selection, routing, and deployment.
* **Close the quality improvement loop.** Translate findings into prioritized improvements to prompts, retrieval, terminology, workflows, and model configurations. Partner with owners to verify fixes and prevent regressions.
* **Operationalize continuous quality monitoring.** Establish regression testing, production sampling, quality dashboards, escalation processes, and ongoing evaluation as models and user needs evolve.
* **Lead cross-functional execution.** Clarify ownership, resolve dependencies, communicate risks, and align stakeholders on quality tradeoffs and launch readiness.

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Operations, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent professional experience.

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of professional experience in program management within a high-growth technology or large-scale enterprise environment.
* Experience leading complex technical programs involving AI/ML, software platforms, quality engineering, or data-driven products.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver cross-functional programs with Engineering, Localization team, Data Scientist, Product, and Operations.
* Working understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, including hallucinations, prompt engineering, prompt injection, RAG, context management, and tool use.
* Experience designing quality metrics, evaluation methodologies, human-review workflows, or experimental programs.
* Ability to interpret statistical results, assess dataset quality, and communicate the limitations of evaluation findings to leaderships and LLMOps.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, and written communication skills, with the ability to turn ambiguous requirements into executable plans.
* Experience evaluating multilingual LLMs, machine translation, conversational AI, or localization quality.
* Familiarity with MQM-based evaluation, terminology governance, and market-specific linguistic requirements.
* Experience with LLM evaluation platforms, automated regression pipelines, and production observability.
* Familiarity with SQL, Python, APIs, and data pipelines sufficient to investigate results and collaborate effectively with technical teams.
* Experience evaluating multimodal systems, including text, image, audio, or video.
* Experience establishing quality standards and launch criteria for AI systems operating at scale.

Who We Are

The San Francisco Unified School District (SFUSD) is the seventh largest school district in California, serving more than 50,000 students who speak more than 44 documented languages across 121 schools in the city of San Francisco every year. We aim for every student who attends SFUSD schools to discover his or her spark, along with a strong sense of self and purpose, and that all students graduate from high school ready for college and career, and equipped with the skills, capacities and dispositions outlined in SFUSD’s Graduate Profile. Every day in our quest to achieve this mission we provide each and every student the quality instruction and equitable support required to thrive in the 21st century.

What It Means to Work Here

The SFUSD community is unified by ourCore Values:

* Student-centered: We put students’ needs first
* Fearless: We persist through challenges
* United: We celebrate and build on each other’s strengths
* Social Justice: We stand with those most vulnerable in our community
* Diversity-driven: We respect and seek to understand each person

We are also inspired by Vision, Values and Guardrails which captures our aspirations and vision for the future of public education in San Francisco. Alongside the District’s strategic plan.SFUSD is reimagining how public education will change over the next decade to meet the dynamic future of San Francisco. As a CORE district, SFUSD is also a leader in critical systems change for more comprehensive school accountability and innovations that help strengthen the instructional core, which is the foundation of our strategic plan and goals.

Who We Want

We want talented people from diverse backgrounds and experiences, who are inspired by our mission, steeped in equity, and who are motivated to unleash our children’s potential. We want people who are strong collaborators, skilled communicators, and problem solvers who are comfortable in a community of continuous learning.

The SFUSD Bond Program manages capital expenditures associated with SFUSD’s voter authorized bond measures. SFUSD has been implementing capital projects funded by voter-approved bonds since 2003. Bond projects are managed by a team of ten project managers, under direction of the Bond Leadership Team, which is part of SFUSD’s Facilities Department. The 5504 Project Manager II is a senior project manager in the program, and a member of the project management team delivering complex projects within this program.

As a 5504 Project Manager II, you manage a broad range of school construction projects that require senior-level experience and aptitude for multi-disciplinary project planning and scoping and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams composed of diverse individuals. You will deliver complex or politically sensitive projects independently as part of SFUSD’s project delivery team. In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

**WHAT YOU NEED**

* Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone
* The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos

* Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

* Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
* Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team's' accomplishments
* Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world's veterinary emergency company.

**Hours:** 40 hours per week – Non – Exempt; 100% In person

**About Street Level Health Project:** Street Level Health Project (SLHP) is an Oakland-based nonprofit dedicated to improving the health, dignity, and well-being of underserved immigrant communities in the Bay Area. For more than two decades, Street Level has served as a trusted point of entry for workers and families facing barriers to healthcare, employment, legal services, and more. Our work is grounded in the belief that everyone deserves dignity, respect, and the opportunity to thrive regardless of immigration status or economic circumstance.

**About the Immigrant Defense (ID) Program:** The ID program works in coalition with partners like the Alameda County Immigration Legal and Education Partnership Rapid Response Network (ACILEP RNN), Adopt-A-Corner, and others to respond to the needs of the immigrant community. This is an agile, responsive program that works closely with the SLHP Day Labor Program and the Health & Well-Being Program. **Position Summary:** The ID Community Care Coordinator (CCC) helps families prepare in case of detention or deportation and supports families impacted by the detention or deportation of a community member. At Sunday, we're developing personal robots to reclaim the hours lost to repetitive tasks. We're focused on an ambitious goal to make generalized robots broadly accessible, enabling households to take back quality time.

We have spent the last 2 years building a talented team, securing capital, and validating our technology. We are now seeking passionate individuals to join us in the next phase of our growth. If you are ready to apply your skills to the forefront of robotics innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

**What to Expect**  
  
We’re looking for an Test Operations Lead to join our Data team and own the operational side of testing the reliability of our hardware and firmware systems.  
  
This role is about piloting and then productionization of both unit and ongoing tests with a team of testers. You’ll work in coordination with Hardware, Firmware, and Data to define the framework and tools on which to build tests around. Your role is vital to ensuring that we get accurate test results in a timely manner and then turning those findings into action items.  
  
What You’ll Do

* Create documentation for testing
* Train testers
* Be in the weeds and test yourself anytime something new is being designed
* Create novel or improve pre-existing testing processes

What You’ll Bring

* Clear written and verbal communication to guide our testers
* Your ability to manage unexpected challenges
* Your ownership of key stakeholders with data operators, engineering, and support
* Excitement for the growth and development of robotics
* Someone adept at prioritization of competing requests, who’s able to move both quickly, and in an organized manner
* A level of hardcore-ness while still treating people like people
* Intermediate level understanding of hardware and firmware

Nice to Have

* Previous experience leading test and validation for technical systems
* Technical skills to build tools for testing
* Ability to leverage AI to help improve productivity

At Sunday Robotics, we’re building technology shaped by real people — curious, creative, and diverse. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, we encourage you to apply. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hold back unless they meet 100% of the criteria — we don’t want that to be the reason we miss out on great talent.

Compensation Range: $180K - $220K

At SimonMed Imaging, the patient experience starts long before an exam takes place. Our Patient Service Specialists play a critical role in facilitating the patient admission flow across our imaging centers. From greeting patients to verifying insurance and processing documentation, this role ensures each visit starts with clarity, efficiency, and care.

We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with empathy, and takes pride in delivering exceptional service. If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and being part of a collaborative healthcare team, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.

**A patient-first mindset:** You treat every interaction with empathy, respect, and genuine concern for patient needs.

**Strong communication and team-oriented approach:** You communicate clearly, listen actively, support patients and teams with professionalism and empathy, and contribute to smooth, collaborative front desk operations.

**Attention to detail:** You accurately collect, process, and maintain patient demographics, insurance information, medical histories, consent forms, and payments with accuracy and care.

**Adaptability and composure:** You stay calm under pressure in high-volume environments, manage competing priorities, and handle sensitive or challenging situations with professionalism.

**Reliability, accountability, and problem-solving:** You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, consistently arrive prepared and ready to support the team, contribute to a positive culture, and help resolve scheduling, billing, and patient flow issues while maintaining a positive patient experience.

### **What You'll Gain**

**A collaborative team environment:** Partner with clinical, operational, and support teams focused on delivering exceptional patient experiences.

**Growth opportunities:** Gain experience in healthcare operations, patient access, and medical administration within a growing organization.

### **You're a Strong Fit if You Have**

* 1+ years of customer service, patient access, medical office, or call center experience preferred

* Experience with scheduling, insurance verification, or healthcare registration processes preferred

* Strong computer and data entry skills

* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

* Experience working with EMR/PM systems preferred

* High school diploma or equivalent required

### **Benefits**

Your health, happiness and future matters!

At SimonMed Imaging, we offer:

* We believe in preventative care for everyone including our team – SimonMed provides free, whole-body scans to each member

* Competitive wages

* No nights/no calls/no weekends

* Cross training opportunities

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance

* 401(k) eligibility

* Pet Insurance

* Paid holidays

* PTO

* Sick Time

We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of drug and background screening. Some positions will require a favorable driving record.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. new_jobs.title: Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980. Today, Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD's headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides community development, real estate facilities, and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low-income US-born high-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional-age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** LFCD is seeking a dedicated and qualified candidate to serve Alameda County’s non-English or Limited English Proficiency CalWORKs (California Work Opportunity and Responsibility to Kids, RCA (Refugee Cash Assistance), GA (General Assistance), and CalFresh (formerly known as Food Stamps) recipients, and low-income individuals in obtaining both subsidized and unsubsidized employment. This position will also manage participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs.This position involves working closely with local employers, training providers, external organizations, and internal LFCD departments. The key responsibilities include providing orientation, conducting intake assessments, creating Individual Employment Plans (IEP), outreach recruitment for employers and job seekers, case management, vocational training counseling, job placement, and offering retention services. The role requires the implementation of program activities and strategies focused on the long-term career advancement of each participant. Additionally, it involves understanding the hiring and business development needs of each employer, adhering to the policy and compliance requirements of Alameda County Social Services Agency, and navigating the various factors that influence an individual’s ability to thrive and advance in the workplace. This position reports to the Program Supervisor and will be stationed at our Oakland Headquarters.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and conduct program orientation sessions, intake and assessments, job readiness workshops, and one-on-one and small group counseling. Develop Welfare-to-Work (WTW2) Plans, IEPs, resumes, and cover letters. Identify participant needs to determine appropriate job interests and matches to secure job placements and provide job retention services.
* Provide intensive services to participants, including certifying and obtaining all required supportive documents for program enrollment. Identify career goals, make appropriate referrals, and provide labor market information, job fairs, job clubs, and job referrals.
* Counsel participants individually and in groups on job search strategies, interviewing skills, and other job readiness topics to assist them in entering the job market, retaining employment, and/or advancing in their careers to become self-sufficient.
* Collaborate effectively with employment teams, VESL instructors, and consortium partners to recommend and refer potential candidates for weekly job openings.
* Take the lead in coordinating, implementing, and managing the Short-Term Food Assistance Program and RSI (Refugee School Impact) / YM (Youth Mentoring) Program, including program planning, participant enrollment, outreach, intake, eligibility determination, service coordination, documentation, follow-up, day-to-day operations, case management, recordkeeping, and reporting to ensure program goals, service outcomes, and grant compliance requirements are met.
* Maintain accurate case records, statistics, and service logs for project reporting purposes. Track participants, enter data, and maintain daily logs, case notes, and all other activities in the internal tracking system and funder-specific CalSAWS database accurately.
* Provide data and administrative support to the Grant Department across various grant-funded programs, including collecting, entering, organizing, reviewing, and verifying program data; maintaining databases, spreadsheets, participant records, and reporting templates; resolving data discrepancies; and supporting data tracking, performance monitoring, and timely grant reporting to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Conduct outreach in the community to provide program information and attend resource fairs to recruit low-income Alameda County residents, including older youth, adults, and dislocated workers. Promote programs by creating flyers and other promotional materials.
* Target and reach out to prospective employers with job openings at reasonable starting wages with fringe benefits. Provide employer orientations, cultivate and maintain business relationships with employers, provide program information, and refer program participants based on their experiences, interests, and job readiness.
* Maintain existing employer business relationships and contracts while developing new business opportunities in the local area to expand the employer directory. Conduct surveys with employers and participants following placement to ensure job stability.
* Prepare and submit monthly program activity reports, performance updates, and other required reports to the program supervisor and Grant Department, as applicable.
* Be knowledgeable about the agency's mission, vision, core values, and strategic plan. Participate in agency initiatives to improve program and service quality and help accomplish the agency's strategic plan goals and objectives.
* Perform other duties as assigned, and participate in organizational and program-related events as needed or assigned by the program supervisor.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

* A Bachelor’s degre

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Sprig**
===============

Sprig is the enterprise survey platform, rebuilt around AI agents.

For two decades, companies have relied on Qualtrics, Medallia, and SurveyMonkey to understand their customers and markets. Those platforms were built for a slower era, with manual setup, fragmented workflows, and insights that arrive too late to shape decisions. The gap between how fast businesses move and how fast research can keep up has never been wider.

We're building something different. With Sprig, AI agents design studies, adapt surveys in real time, and turn responses into clear insight. Research, insights, and customer experience teams move from question to evidence in hours instead of weeks, without sacrificing rigor.

Our mission is to make deep customer understanding effortless and always on, so the world's leading companies can act on evidence instead of assumptions.

Leading companies like Microsoft, TikTok, DoorDash, and Coinbase trust Sprig to conduct research at scale. Backed by $85M in funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, and First Round Capital, we're rapidly expanding our enterprise presence.

We’re redefining the category, with AI at the core. If you're excited to solve hard problems and have the chance to shape how the world's largest companies understand their customers, we'd love to meet you.

**About the Role**
==================

We're hiring an **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to own and grow relationships with some of the world's leading companies. You'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor, helping enterprise customers unlock the full value of Sprig, scale adoption across their organizations, and turn customer insights into meaningful business outcomes.

You'll own the **end-to-end customer lifecycle** for a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, from onboarding and adoption through expansion and renewal. Working closely with Sales, Product, and other cross-functional teams, you'll build executive relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive strong customer retention and Net Revenue Retention (NRR).

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping how leading enterprises adopt AI-powered research, while directly influencing Sprig's product and customer success strategy.

This role is based in our **San Francisco office 4 days per week**, with travel up to 25%.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* **Own strategic enterprise relationships**, serving as the primary advisor and driving customer success, retention, and account growth.
* **Drive adoption and measurable business value** through onboarding, enablement, and strategic success plans that expand Sprig's impact across teams.
* **Identify and execute expansion opportunities**, leveraging product usage, customer priorities, and stakeholder relationships to grow account revenue.
* **Build executive partnerships** with senior decision-makers, leading strategic business reviews and demonstrating Sprig's value and ROI.
* **Lead renewals and protect revenue** by proactively managing account health, identifying risks, and strengthening long-term customer relationships.
* **Champion the voice of the customer**, partnering with Sales and Product to influence the roadmap, improve the customer experience, and scale successful engagement strategies.

**Your Strengths**
------------------

* **5+ years of experience** in enterprise Customer Success, Account Management, or strategic consulting, ideally within B2B SaaS.
* **Proven success managing complex enterprise accounts**, with a track record of driving retention, expansion, and revenue growth.
* **Strong commercial instincts**, with the ability to uncover growth opportunities, navigate renewals, and connect product value to business outcomes.
* **Executive presence and relationship-building skills**, with experience influencing senior stakeholders and navigating complex organizations.
* **Strategic and analytical mindset**, using customer data, product usage, and business insights to develop actionable success plans.
* **Exceptional communication and project management skills**, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities.
* **Proactive, resourceful, and adaptable**, thriving in a fast-paced environment where you can take ownership, solve problems, and help build scalable processes.

**Benefits & Perks**
--------------------

* Competitive Salary
* Competitive Employee Equity
* 401K Program
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
* FSA/HSA Benefit
* $175/month Commuter Benefit
* Additional Wellbeing Benefits
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Professional Development Stipend
* Hybrid Office Policy
* Lunch and dinner daily
* Company Sponsored Social Events

At Sprig, we pride ourselves on being a people-first company, where your contributions truly matter and are valued. We were recently awarded by Fortune as top 50 best places to work in the US, and top 50 Places to Work in the Bay Area by Built In. Come join our mission of building products users love and have a real impact on Sprig’s future.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------------------------

We prioritize diversity within our team and value different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds to apply.

**Employee Pay Disclosure**
---------------------------

The OTE range for this full-time position is $170,000 - $200,000 + Equity + Benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all locations (San Francisco, CA; New York, NY). Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.  
  
For over a decade, we've believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.  
  
We're 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.  
  
Come join us!

**About the Role**
------------------

This is a build role. You'll own the day-to-day growth of our strategic partners, anchored in the CRM Solutions Partner ecosystem (Salesforce, HubSpot, and similar), and help us diversify beyond it into resellers, MSPs, TSDs, and verticalized tech partners. Today a meaningful share of partner-sourced pipeline flows through a few tech integrations: real momentum, and real concentration risk.

* Experience running joint business plans and co-selling with senior partner stakeholders.

Our name reflects our mission - Forza means "strength," representing the power of our team, and *Care* reflects our compassion for those we serve.

**ForzaCare is proud to be part of Ethos Risk Services,** a leading national provider of investigative and risk mitigation solutions. Together, we're expanding our reach and strengthening our ability to deliver exceptional service across the workers' compensation industry. Learn more about ForzaCare and Ethos partnership here.

new_jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
new_jobs.description:
**Lead Care Manager (ECM Support Counselor)**

Join our team as an ECM Support Counselor and take part in transforming the way Medi-Cal members with complex needs receive care and support.

As an ECM Support Counselor, you'll serve as the primary point of contact for Medi-Cal members enrolled in Enhanced Care Management (ECM). You will conduct outreach research across healthcare, community-based, and social-service settings throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to identify opportunities for connecting with and enrolling new client-members. You'll develop trusting relationships with members and provide comprehensive, individualized care management that addresses medical, behavioral health, and health-related social needs.

Working primarily in the community, you'll coordinate with health care providers, social service agencies, community organizations, and other members of the care team to ensure members receive the right services at the right time.

This is a full-time, benefited role with significant community-based work. The position requires flexibility to meet members where they live and receive services, including homes, health care settings, community centers, and other community locations. The ideal candidate is compassionate, organized, has strong public speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and effectively with individuals or community groups, comfortable working in community-based settings, and culturally responsive and can support to individuals and families from diverse backgrounds.

  

**About Alternative Family Services**

Alternative Family Services is a Foster Family, Adoption and Mental Health Agency that has been serving abused and neglected children in our community since 1973. Our mission is to support vulnerable children and families in need of stability, safety, and well-being in communities. We provide a wide range of foster, adoption, mental health and transition-aged youth services in English and Spanish. We have eight locations throughout the Bay Area and over 200 employees. We celebrate diversity, equal opportunity, and excellence.

  

**Responsibilities and What You’ll Do**

* Build relationships with community-based, social service, healthcare and other partner organizations throughout the San Francisco Bay Area to increase awareness of ECM services and generate new client-member enrollment.
* Identify and engage with community-based, social-service or healthcare organizations to generate new client-member enrollment and strengthen community partnerships
* Plan, coordinate and participate in community outreach events to increase awareness and enrolment of ECM services, foster relationships with prospective clients, and generate new client-member enrollment
* Serve as the member’s primary point of contact, providing individualized and comprehensive care management; provide direct support services such as mentoring, skill-building, coaching, tutoring, and crisis response
* Develop person-centered care plans in partnership with members, their families or support systems, and the care team
* Meet with client-members in their homes and communities to assess needs, provide support, and help remove barriers to care
* Help client-members navigate health care and social service systems and connect them to appropriate providers and community resources across multiple systems
* Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure client-members successfully access recommended services
* Maintain regular communication with health plans, providers, community-based organizations, and other members of the interdisciplinary care team
* Advocate for members and help ensure their preferences, goals and needs remain central to their care
* Maintain accurate and timely documentation in accordance with organizational, Medi-Cal, and health plan requirements
* Maintain confidentiality and compliance with HIPAA and applicable privacy standards
* Monitor member progress and update care plans as needs and circumstances change
* Participate in care team meetings, case consultations, and other activities designed to improve coordination and outcomes
* Respond appropriately to urgent member needs and help connect members to crisis or emergency resources when necessary

  

**Qualifications**

* Ability to obtain and maintain fingerprint and government and Agency required background clearances
* CPR/First Aid certification
* Valid California driver’s license with an acceptable driving record, auto insurance showing as an insured driver on the policy and vehicle registration
* A bachelor’s degree in a social science related field; or an associate degree in a social science related field and have at least six months experience in working with emotionally disturbed children or children who have a serious behavioral problem; or at least two years of experience working with emotionally disturbed children or children who have a serious behavioral problem, and who demonstrate a combination of education, skills, and experience
* Experience providing case management, care coordination, social services, behavioral health services, health care services, or related support to individuals with complex needs
* Experience as an outreach coordinator and comfortability with public speaking
* Knowledge of county and community resources and the ability to connect members to social service programs
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience working with individuals experiencing complex medical, behavioral health, housing, food insecurity, or other social needs
* Ability to maintain accurate documentation and manage multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up activities
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with an interdisciplinary care team
* Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, cultural humility, and person-centered care
* Able to interact with co-workers, county representatives, and other treatment team members as part of a coop

Astranis is a fast-growing company where hardware, software, and operations teams ship on a tight schedule. The tools to work faster, especially AI tools, are already here. What we need now is someone to help every team use them well.

As our AI Enablement & Learning and Development Lead, you will own how Astranis learns. For your first three quarters, your focus is AI enablement: getting real, measurable adoption of the tools we already have. From there, you will broaden into a full learning and development function, including team-level onboarding, on-demand skills training, and a manager academy. You will be a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and runs programs yourself, with room to grow the function and, over time, scale into a leadership role.

You will report to the Director of Employee Success and sit on our AI Steering Committee.

#### **Role**

Execute on our AI Enablement Strategy (this is the focus for the first three quarters)

  + Coordinate company-wide hackathons twice a year, owning logistics, communications, judging, and follow-through so winning ideas turn into real workflow improvements.

* Build and launch a leadership academy program scoped for director-level leaders.
* Establish simple, repeatable ways to measure whether training works, and use what you learn to improve every program.
* Create lightweight systems, templates, and a knowledge base so learning scales beyond live sessions.
* Develop a framework to assess the feasibility and business case for an engineering rotational program, define program requirements and structure, and lead the design, development, and implementation of the program if approved.

#### **Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in learning and development, enablement, change management, or internal training, ideally at a fast-growing technology or engineering company.
* A track record of running adoption or enablement programs end to end and being able to show the results with data.
* Hands-on fluency with AI tools. You use them regularly and can teach others to use them well, from complete beginners to power users.
* Strong instructional design and facilitation skills, in live workshops and in self-serve formats.
* Experience building or running internal communities, events, or hackathons.
* Comfort earning trust with highly technical employees and managers who are very busy.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to work independently, prioritize across many requests, and move quickly with limited process.

#### **Bonus**

* Experience launching a manager or leadership development program.
* Background supporting engineering, aerospace, or other deeply technical teams.
* Familiarity with learning platforms or LMS tools, and with analytics for tracking usage and engagement.
* Experience partnering with executives or a steering committee on technology rollouts.

new_jobs.description:
#### **Job Title: Project Manager, Whole Person Health**

Location: Bethesda, Maryland (Remote)

Reports To: Director, Whole Person Health

FLSA Status: Exempt

Must be able to provide proof of residence in one of these states: KS, MA, MD, MI, NC, NJ, NY, TN, TX, PA, VA, WA, WV, or DC

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Position Summary:**

The Project Manager, Whole Person Health is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of projects and initiatives in the Whole Person Health portfolio. This role will focus on the continuous improvement of NACHC's PRAPARE ® (Protocol for Responding to and Assessing Patients' Assets, Risks, and Experiences) portfolio.

This role requires strong project management and organizational skills in addition to working knowledge of whole-person screening assessments and healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD-10-CM, HL7® FHIR®, Gravity Project).

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

1. Project and Portfolio Management

* Lead the planning, implementation, management, and evaluation of assigned projects and strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate activities across crossfunctional teams, partners, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Monitor progress toward project goals, deliverables, and performance measures.
* Develop reports, presentations, and communications for leadership and stakeholder audiences.
* Conduct project reviews, evaluate outcomes, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Ensure adherence to organizational policies, contractual requirements, and operational expectations, as applicable.
* Support development and implementation of sustainable processes, resources, and tools that advance organizational priorities.

2. Health Center Engagement and Technical Assistance

* Provide technical assistance to health centers, PCAs, and HCCNs implementing PRAPARE® and social needs screening workflows.
* Support health center efforts to integrate PRAPARE® into electronic health records and care coordination processes.
* Facilitate peer learning opportunities focused on PRAPARE® implementation challenges and best practices.
* Respond to PRAPARE ®inquiries and provide ongoing support and resources to participating organizations.

3. Training, Education, and Learning Collaboratives

* Design and manage national learning collaboratives, webinars, workshops, and conference sessions related to PRAPARE® implementation.
* Develop educational materials, toolkits, implementation guides, and training curricula.
* Coordinate faculty, subject matter experts, and advisory groups supporting PRAPARE® initiatives.
* Facilitate virtual and inperson meetings focused on social needs screening and intervention strategies.
* Promote dissemination of promising practices and innovative health center models.

4. Data, Evaluation, and Quality Improvement

* Support collection, analysis, and interpretation of PRAPARE®related data and related interoperability standards. (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project)
* Support the development dashboards, reports, briefs, presentations, and infographics that communicate findings and impact.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen use of PRAPARE® data for population health management, quality improvement, and health equity initiatives.
* Support efforts related to data standardization, interoperability, and reporting requirements.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and Partnership Development

* Build and maintain relationships with health centers, PCAs, HCCNs, federal agencies, health information technology partners, communitybased organizations, and national stakeholders.
* Represent NACHC at conferences, meetings, workgroups, and national forums.
* Support development of strategic partnerships that advance PRAPARE® adoption and sustainability.
* Engage external stakeholders in collaborative efforts to address whole person health and community wellbeing.

6. PRAPARE® Licensing and Stewardship

* Manage the administration and oversight of PRAPARE® licensing agreements, including onboarding, renewals, and stakeholder communications.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for organizations seeking to adopt, implement, or expand use of PRAPARE®.
* Maintain accurate licensing records, documentation, and tracking systems to support program operations and reporting.
* Coordinate licensing processes and ensure compliance with PRAPARE® usage requirements and organizational policies.
* Build and maintain relationships with licensed organizations and partners to support adoption, sustainability, and effective use of PRAPARE®.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

#### **Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Master's degree preferred in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Social Work, Public Policy, Healthcare Management, or a related field; relevant experience may be substituted for advanced education.
* Working knowledge of PRAPARE® and its application in community health center settings.
* Experience implementing or supporting PRAPARE within clinical, community health, or population health settings.
* Experience supporting implementation of screening, referral, care coordination, population health, or quality improvement initiatives.
* Experience supporting wholeperson health screening, assessment, referral, and community resource connection programs
* Knowledge of healthcare data standards and coding frameworks (e.g. LOINC, SNOMED CT, ICD10CM, HL7® FHIR®, and Gravity Project), and related interoperability standards.
* Experience working with electronic health records (EHRs), health information exchange, interoperability initiatives, or social needs data collection and reporting efforts.
* 10% travel to NACHC conferences and events.

Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. **An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As a Revenue Technology Manager at GitLab, you'll lead how the tools we build and buy work together as we grow our consumption-based business. You'll own the vision, roadmap, and requirements for internal go-to-market applications, starting with Command Center, which helps field teams act on product usage and consumption data. You'll decide what those applications need to do and how they should fit with the rest of the stack. Engineering will own their technical architecture, code, and infrastructure. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Director, Revenue Technology, within Revenue Operations.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Define how internal and third-party tools fit together, including integrations, data flows, and governance, in partnership with the people who manage each tool.
* Recommend when to build, buy, or consolidate tools based on cost, return on investment, and how well each option meets the needs of go-to-market teams.
* Own the roadmap for Command Center and other internal applications. Turn requests from Sales, Solutions Architecture, Customer Experience, Product, and Ecosystem into clear requirements, and explain what you won't prioritize and why.
* Partner with Engineering to deliver applications that fit the existing stack and limit technical debt. Lead user acceptance testing, launch, documentation, and enablement, then use adoption data to decide what to improve, expand, or retire.
* Set the long-term direction of the revenue technology stack with Revenue Strategy, Revenue Operations, and field leaders as the business and artificial intelligence capabilities evolve.
* Build artificial intelligence and automation workflows that save time for Revenue Technology and go-to-market teams, and help the team decide when to use them.
* Bring consumption metrics into the tools and workflows field teams rely on, and adapt them as GitLab's consumption model matures.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Experience in Revenue Operations, Sales or Customer Success Operations, business systems, or a related role, with ownership of tools from defining the use case and choosing a solution through launch.
* Experience designing or guiding a go-to-market technology stack, including how tools connect and share data through application programming interfaces, integrations, data models, and permissions. Working knowledge of Salesforce, product usage data, and revenue tools such as Gainsight, Clari, Gong, or Outreach.
