* Strong written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment. You can prioritize your work, keep teammates informed, and collaborate through issues, documents, and merge requests.

Experience querying data directly with Structured Query Language (SQL) or a comparable tool, working with go-to-market analytics, or supporting field enablement is helpful, not required. We welcome transferable skills from related roles.

Revenue Technology owns the tools GitLab's go-to-market teams use, whether we build them or buy them. new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About By the Pixel**

By the Pixel is an established digital agency headquartered in Denver, Colorado, with remote team members across the U.S. Since 2010, we've designed and built high-end web applications for clients in healthcare, automotive sales, research and development, hospitality, the nonprofit sector, and more.

We support our clients end-to-end: strategy, design, custom development, hosting, tiered production support, SEO, paid advertising, and content marketing. Most of what we build is engineered from scratch, because a one-size-fits-all bundle rarely fits.

**How this role fits**

The Project Manager runs projects from scoping through delivery and manages ongoing retainer and support work, coordinating the internal team and keeping work on schedule and within its approved budget. You'll work closely with the Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and anything commercial, and with the Project Strategist, who owns what gets built and why on projects that have one.

**What you'll own**

**Project Planning & Scoping**

* Leads scoping and estimating for proposed and upcoming work, defining scope and deliverables with the project department leads and other subject matter experts on the team, and working from the goals and requirements the Project Strategist sets where one is assigned.
* Works with the Account Manager throughout scoping so estimates reflect the client's budget and commercial constraints.
* Updates estimates with department leads as requirements change during the project.
* Creates and maintains the project schedule, timeline, and plan, incorporating the client-side deadlines and contractual commitments the Account Manager supplies.
* Looks for ways to simplify how work is sequenced and structured, reducing the handoffs and dependencies that slow a project down.
* Decides when a project is better served by sprints than by a timeline-based structure, and runs them accordingly.

**Driving Progress**

* Plans and leads project kickoff meetings, ensuring the client and internal team are aligned on goals, roles, expectations, and next steps before work begins.
* Follows up on unclear requirements, pending decisions, and unresolved dependencies to prevent work from stalling, and brings in the Project Strategist for requirements questions when one is assigned.
* Tracks what the client and third-party vendors owe the project, such as content, assets, access, and approvals, and follows up when any of it is late.
* Identifies risks and blockers with the project team early, resolves them, and escalates any it cannot resolve to the Account Manager as soon as they arise.
* Monitors project progress daily and keeps the project team and Account Manager informed of status, upcoming milestones, and changes to timeline or scope.
* Tracks project budget and flags overages or scope changes to the Account Manager.
* Makes sure contributors log their time to the correct project and task, since budget tracking, time reports, and invoicing depend on it.
* Collects reports from department leads when time on a task exceeds expectations, and passes them to the Account Manager with enough context to decide what should be invoiced.
* Routes out-of-scope client requests to the Account Manager, and does not schedule or begin the work until the Account Manager has approved the additional budget.

**Team Coordination**

* Collaborates with the project department leads to delegate tasks based on each contributor's expertise, availability, and capacity.
* Gets contributors the information and resources they need to complete their work without delay.
* Coordinates handoffs between internal departments, running the meetings and communication each one needs.
* Identifies opportunities for ad hoc collaboration across the team, connecting contributors who can help each other even when they do not regularly work together.
* Works with Managers to build project teams that meet the needs of each engagement.

**Client Communication**

* Serves as the client's day-to-day contact for project schedules, status, and deliverables.
* Schedules and leads project and client meetings, preparing agendas, documenting outcomes, and following up on action items.
* Generates required project reports, including status updates, monthly summaries of work delivered, and weekly time reports.
* Sets expectations with clients on timelines and deliverables, and brings in the Account Manager before discussing any change that affects scope or budget.
* Schedules and coordinates client demos, which the relevant department lead runs.
* Runs client review rounds, setting the review schedule and feedback deadlines and collecting the client's feedback in one place for the Project Strategist or department leads to act on.
* Confirms each deliverable is complete, has passed department lead review and QA, and has the Project Strategist's sign-off where one is assigned before it reaches the client.

**Launch & Closeout**

* Plans each launch with the department leads, including the go-live checklist, launch timing, and who is available to support it.
* Confirms the Account Manager has the client's written acceptance of the final deliverables before closing the project.
* Closes out the project, resolving or reassigning any open tasks.
* Transitions the project to support or a retainer, documenting what was delivered and what remains open, and explaining to the client how to submit requests going forward.

**Retainers & Support Queues**

* Plans the work for each retainer period with the client and department leads, within the hours agreed with the client.
* Tracks retainer hours used against each period's allotment and tells the Account Manager when a client is on pace to go over or under.
* Triages incoming support requests by severity and assigns each to the appropriate contributor.
* Keeps the client updated on open support requests until each one is resolved.
* Escalates urgent production issues to the relevant department

**SUMMARY**:

  

The Project Manager is responsible for managing New Program Launches (NPLs) from initiation through completion and for continuously improving NPL processes. This individual serves as a key liaison across internal teams, including Partnership Services, Marketing, Enrollment Services, and Sales, and as a dedicated PM resource for university partners. The Project Manager also serves as the Onboarding lead for OnRamp, AllCampus’s new line of service offerings for prospective partners.

  

A core part of this role is applying AI to how launches get done. The Project Manager will identify, design, build, and scale AI-enabled workflows (such as automated status reporting, onboarding playbooks, meeting capture, and task tracking) that make NPL and OnRamp delivery faster, more consistent, and easier to scale as partner volume grows.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Project and launch management**

* Serves on the NPL Team and independently manages NPLs and OnRamp onboardings from initiation through delivery, ensuring launches are on time, within scope, and in line with stakeholder expectations
* Serves as the key facilitator between project teams, cross-functional departments, external vendors, and partners; leads project meetings, documents decisions and action items, and keeps stakeholders aligned on goals, deliverables, and timelines
* Develops and maintains comprehensive project plans and NPL and OnRamp production boards, tracking milestones and dependencies, updating workflows and timelines, and adjusting resources to resolve capacity constraints and launch risks
* Serves as the Onboarding lead for OnRamp, AllCampus’s new line of service offerings, guiding prospective partners from initial meetings and requirements gathering through internal system setup and launch
* Identifies potential roadblocks early, leads problem-solving sessions to drive resolution through collaboration, and escalates issues to the AVP, Operations when appropriate
* Conducts New Program Launch “lessons learned” meetings, and identifies and implements efficiency improvements, including AI and automation opportunities
* Partners with teams across the organization to lead process improvement initiatives and support documentation for Operations, Marketing, and partner program launches
* Manages the partner off-boarding process
* Serves as back-up to the Marketing Project Manager

**AI enablement and process efficiency**

* Identifies opportunities to apply AI across the NPL and OnRamp lifecycle, then designs, builds, and maintains AI-enabled workflows such as automated status updates, meeting summaries and action-item capture, requirements-gathering templates, and launch checklists
* Uses AI assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini) together with Smartsheet, Slack, Google Workspace, and the internal CRM to automate recurring reporting and reduce manual task tracking
* Builds and maintains a library of reusable AI prompts, templates, and documentation so NPL and OnRamp processes are repeatable and can be adopted by the broader team
* Contributes to the roadmap for automating and streamlining NPL and OnRamp processes, prioritizing improvements by impact and effort
* Measures the impact of AI-driven improvements (e.g., hours saved, launch cycle time, on-time delivery rate) and reports results to the AVP, Operations

* Performs other duties as assigned

  

**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE** **an equivalent combination of education, training and experience will be considered.**

* Bachelor's degree required, Master's degree preferred
* 3–5 years of project management, including independently managing complex, cross-functional projects; experience in higher education and client management preferred
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience using generative AI tools to improve project management or operational workflows, including prompt design, validating AI outputs
* Experience building automations or integrations (e.g., Smartsheet automations, Zapier, Slack workflows, or API-based tools) strongly preferred
* Project management certification preferred; AI or automation certification a plus
* A collaborative approach and the ability to get cross-functional teams working toward the same goal
* Strong organizational skills and the flexibility to adapt when priorities or plans change
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including confidence working with clients, leaders, consultants, and subject matter experts
* The ability to identify problems, facilitate decisions, and keep projects moving forward
* Curiosity and a continuous-improvement mindset; keeps current on emerging AI tools and evaluates where they add value

  

**COMPUTER SKILLS/TOOLS NEEDED TO PERFORM THE JOB** **which may be representative but not all inclusive of those commonly associated with this position.**

* Project management software and tools
* Proficiency with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and connecting them to everyday business systems

**Customer Success Manager, Accounts & Retention**  
  
**About the Role**  
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you own a book of higher ed accounts from the welcome meeting through every renewal. You're the customer's main contact at Kuali and the person who knows their goals, their people, and how they actually use our products. You also own the renewal, so retention and growth in your book are yours to drive.  
  
This is an account management role. Product owns the roadmap and decides what gets built. Your part is to understand what each customer needs, bring that context to Product through our intake process, and keep the customer posted on what happens next. You don't need to know the roadmap by heart, and you won't be asked to make feature commitments.  
  
You also won't have every answer, especially in your first months. Customers will ask about integrations, data, and edge cases you haven't seen before. We want someone who's at ease saying they'll check, knows who to ask inside Kuali, and closes the loop with the customer quickly.  
  
The job is part relationship work and part operations. You'll spend time on calls and on campus, and you'll also work in Salesforce and ChurnZero tracking health scores, renewal dates, and next steps. You'll partner with Sales, Implementation, Support, and Product, and you'll bring the customer's view into each of those conversations.

**Who are we?**

Kuali builds software for colleges and universities. Our products cover forms and workflow (Build), emergency and continuity planning (Ready), curriculum and student systems (Student), research administration (Research), financials, and student outreach (Reach).Campus teams use Kuali to run work that used to live in paper, email, and spreadsheets.

Our Customer Success team owns the relationship with every customer after the contract is signed. We're growing that team and building out how we work with accounts, so you'll have a real say in the playbooks, metrics, and habits we settle on.

**Our Culture**  
As a company, we are guided by our cultural values:

* Iterate to evolve
* Cultivate openness
* Act with accountability
* Assume the best
* Practice humility
* Deliver amazing experiences

We learn from and teach each other, we practice transparency and empathy, we delight in delivering value to our customers, and we WIN!

We work remotely, and have for years. Distributed work is in our bones, with a history of institutions working across state lines on open-source software for more than ten years. Our employees each work in the environment where they’re happiest, from Pennsylvania to Seattle. We work consciously to create a collaborative and healthy remote work culture, and we travel to meet in person a few times each year. We feel it’s important for employees to come to work refreshed and ready for the week so we have a four day work week policy, Monday-Thursday.

  
**Everyone should love their work.**

Kuali has been voted a top place to work for 8 years by the Salt Lake Tribune. We also made Forbes' list of America's Best Startup Employers for 2020. Most recently, in 2024 TIME Magazine honored us by naming Kuali to their list of the World’s Top EdTech Companies, ranking us #99 overall and #37 in the US.

At Kuali, we embrace diversity and inclusion at every level. We value and respect individuals from all backgrounds, recognizing that a rich tapestry of experiences and perspectives fuels our success as a company and enriches our collective human experience.

**About you**

* **You align with Kuali’s values:** You are excited to contribute to an environment that reflects them.
* **You are detail-oriented:** You have an amazing attention to detail and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
* **You are an amazing communicator:** You are a great listener and communication is clear, concise, and tailored to your audience. You possess strong editing skills.
* **You are organized, communicative, and accountable:** You possess excellent organization and prioritization skills. You own your role entirely, while being open to feedback, suggestions, edits, and new ideas.
* **You are self-motivated and eager to grow:** You have a thirst for knowledge especially within higher education. You are proactive and your enthusiasm shows.
* **You are resourceful and solution-oriented:** When you're faced with a problem, you work to solve it with tact, persistence, and urgency.
* **You are Resourceful:** You have the ability to conduct research and synthesize information from multiple sources (subject matter experts, previous proposals) into a cohesive, easy-to-read, and persuasive final product. You are good at adapting to various people and personalities.
* **You are able to multitask effectively:** You are good at working on multiple concurrent projects that sometimes have short turn-around times.
* **You are team oriented and set up for success on a remote team:** You love being helpful and supportive and thrive on the successes of the team. You’re comfortable being part of a fully remote team, and you have a suitable home working environment or alternative.

**What you’ll be responsible for**  
  
**Account ownership and renewals**

* Own gross and net revenue retention for your book of business.
* Run the renewal process for each account, starting about 120 days before the renewal date.
* Build a success plan for each account that covers the customer's goals, how they'll measure success, and the risks you see.

* Watch account health and act when an account turns yellow or red.
